The new season at Bondi introduces fresh faces with trainee Ryan, Maxi's cousin, who struggles with the megaphone. New recruit Chris from Western Australia faces a life-and-death situation. Mario tackles his first mass rescue on the jet ski. Young Jethro hits it off with a pair of drag queens.

Snoop Dogg visits Bondi on New Years. Lifeguards arrive at 5am, rescuing partygoers from rips. One girl loses consciousness, but lifeguard suspect she is a serial offender intentionally endangering herself. The emergency chopper is called for a missing swimmer last seen in the water two hours ago.

A man loses control of his car and crashes on to Bondi Beach. Harries and Trainee Harrison are first on the scene. Taco's traineeship is coming to an end after more than a few ups and downs. He's going all out to impress Boss Hoppo before he leaves - but it all goes wrong when he flips the jetski.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

Despite being an overweight kid without a surfing background, Reidy has overcome harsh criticism to become a lifeguard, setting his sights on a world record. Lifeguards must rescue a girl blown kilometres out to sea on a paddle board. A BMX rider has a fractured cheek and broken nose.

A severe heatwave ends abruptly with Bondi experiencing the biggest hailstorm in 20 years. Harrison makes a daring move to save members of a Korean tour group caught in a rip. Reidy attempts to become the greatest Bondi Santa and the lifeguards receive a special Christmas gift from a local legend.

Bra Boy Jesse rescues a vicious rat from the skate bowl, lifeguards play detectives after a punch-up in the surf break, and Harries swims more than a kilometre out to sea. None of this is in the lifeguard manual, but the boys tackle it with lifeguard ingenuity and a healthy dose of humour.

Tragedy unfolds as a Chinese backpacker is left comatose after-hours. A father loses his son in a massive crowd. Lifeguards struggle communicating with the distressed Cambodian man. Former ironman Kailan Collins shares the details of his rare injury for the first time in seventeen years.
In a frenzied mass rescue, lifeguards search for a student who didn't make it back to the beach. Bagus and Hoppo witness an assault on a woman. Harrison makes a young fan cry - for the right reasons.

Lifeguards lay down the law after a woman reports being spat on at Bondi Beach. New lifeguard Will attends a medical emergency involving an unconscious teenager. In the midst of a howling gale, a woman brings a fleet of giant inflatables to Bondi. Local larrikin Harries helps tame the wild toys.

Big swell and powerful rips at Bondi's south corner. Lifeguard Yatesy attempts the rescue of an inexperienced surfer in 10-foot swell. Meanwhile, increased shark sightings prompt the lifeguards to test new deterrent technology for the future safety of Bondi swimmers and lifeguards.

On the first sunny day of December, one man falls off the jetski rescue mat unnoticed. A dance party with 3000 backpackers behind the lifeguard tower results in numerous drug and alcohol-related issues. As the crowd swells to 40,010, head lifeguard Hoppo must decide whether to clear the water.

Christmas crowds at Bondi overwhelm lifeguards. Caught between minor rescues and serious situations, Maxi makes a wrong decision. Jake struggles with numerous rescues on the jetski. Jackson rushes through the crowd to save a drunk woman in a rip, earning a surprising Christmas kiss.

Amidst the bustling crowds at Bondi, two men start drowning at the north end. Californian bodybuilder Ike Catcher arrives to challenge Harries for the 'King-of-Bondi' title. The real King-of-Bondi test is the annual lifeguard challenge, when everyone races to decide which lifeguard is the fastest.

Bondi faces a bluebottle invasion. Lifeguards treat a boy from the UK stung by the painful creatures. Singlets attends a suspected spinal injury, shocked to find that the patient is his son, Star recruit Clint Kimmins uses his big wave surfing skills for a daring rescue of a drowning man.

It's Mr. Kim's first day of work and he's already in turmoil. His team already hates him and on top of that, the new finance director orders him to do something he's unwilling to do.

Mr. Kim saves a woman by accident and gets the nickname Mr. Righteous. Even with this nickname, Hagyeong still dislikes him. Meanwhile, Hagyeong decides to help Yooseon in saving the company from bad people.
Mr. Kim is arrested for forging documents. Seo Yul, who has obtained weak spots of Mr. Kim decides to use him and gets him out of the custody in return for Mr. Kim's loyalty.

Mr. Kim is always an accidental hero of good people, but this time he gets kidnapped by thugs by accident as they mistook him as a head of labor union. Meanwhile, the Seoahn Jangryong asks Mr. Kim to be in DF team.

TQ Group takes Mr. Kim in thinking that he is the leader of the Labor Union and makes a deal with him to immediately stop the protest. Mr. Kim has to decide whether he will accept the deal or not. Mr. Kim is also approached by the police for document forgery and they say it's real this time.
Hagyeong and Yooseon help Mr. Kim out of his charges, and Yul gets someone to find out who got him out. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim is sent to the waiting room for ruining the company reputation.

The mysterious maiden who performed the solo dance during the King's birthday festival is nowhere to be found, and the Crown Prince suspects Eunuch Hong to be the one. Meanwhile, Raon is given a vacation and she plans to attend the Lantern Festival in the village. While she is waiting for Yunseong, she runs into the Crown Prince and they fly a wish lantern together.

Eunuch Ma secretly tells Envoy Mok Taegam that Eunuch Hong is a girl and the dancer he has been desperately looking for. The envoy calls in Raon to his room at night, and the Crown Prince stops him right when he is about to harass her. However, the Crown Prince gets into trouble due to his disrespectful attitude toward the envoy.

Eunuch Ma and Wolhee must end their relationship because a eunuch and court lady's love cannot be done. Eunuch Hong attempts to deliver his sincerity through a puppet play, and Eunuch Ma professes his feelings for her in front of people. Meanwhile, despite of the rumors and his status, the Crown Prince decides not to hide his feelings toward Eunuch Hong.

Yeong is about to start ruling as an interim king, but the conflict regarding the national exam between Yeong and Kim Heon deepens. After Yeong's profession of his feelings to Raon, she feels awful because she can't tell him the truth about her. Meanwhile, as Hayeon gets to love Yeong more and more, she goes to meet Raon for advice.

Yeong continues to postpone the national exam to stop the corruption, which leads to more deepened conflicts with Kim Heon. Even students who have been preparing the exam address an appeal to the king. Meanwhile, having heard that Yeong would treat her as a lady, Raon starts to avoid him.

Raon tells Yeong a story about the mermaid who falls in love with a prince and turns into sea-foam in the end. Both of them realize that they will eventually become like the mermaid and the prince since Yeong has to marry someone whose family can give him political power and Raon has to pretend she'd be all right and disappear.

The King persuades Yeong that he must marry Minister Cho's daughter to have more people on his side. Raon also persuades him to marry her since she doesn't want to cause any harm to him. The decision seems to be inevitable if he wants to keep his promise to become a king who always considers the best for the nation and the people.

Sonic and Tails find an underground world of diamonds, but they are held captive there by a miserly Mole-Troll. When Robotnik comes to capture them, he accidently frees them from the Mole-Troll, who teams up with Sonic and Tails to defend his riches.

Sonic saves a damsel in distress, and falls in love with her, not knowing she's a robot built by Robotnik. But when she has a chance to trap him, she helps him escape, realizing she has fallen for him.

When Scratch and Grounder use Robotnik's new Slo-Mo Ray Gun to capture Sonic, Tails rescues him by reversing the gun and turning it on a tribe of friendly Tree Sloth People who become a high speed commando strike force against Robotnik.

Tails and other Mobius citizens are lured into Robotnik's robotic games of chance, and when they lose they're sent to slave labor camps. Sonic rescues Tails and the others by beating the house in games of chance at Robotnik's Casino.
In order to free Sketch Lampoon (a satirical comic book artist) from Robotnik's new high security prison, Sonic allows himself to be captured, then makes a high speed rescue and escape.

When Tails gets trapped in the "Warp of Confusion" (an Escher-like world of another dimension) by Robotnik's cousin, Dr. Warpnik, Sonic comes to the rescue and traps Robotnik and his badniks in the warp.

programmes.st: Close Encounter of the Sonic Kind

Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programmes.d: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programmes.t: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
programmes.d: Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

After a Commonwealth planet is attacked by Pyrian pyroformers, Dylan is forced to fight to protect the new planet.
Dylan hears voices beckoning him to a planet of "fire and ice," so he pursues, even though it means crossing hostile Nietzschean-controlled space.
While caught in a battle between two Nietzschean prides, the crew captures a hostile who claims that his pride possesses a map of the slipstream.
A wrong turn after exiting a slipstream sends the Andromeda into the Prolon system. They rescue an escape pod from certain disaster, but the pride wants it back.
The crew seeks a lost colony of Nietzscheans and discovers another crew that has been secretly helping them.

News & entertainment for people who love America.
The latest in culture, news, theology and politics from a Christian, conservative perspective.
When Danny and Kate come up empty-handed with leads for a shooting, Linda helps make a break in the case when she overhears the victim telling his priest who is responsible.
Jamie must deal with the emotional consequences of his actions on the job.
When Danny's car matches an NYPD description of a vehicle involved in a drug deal, he is stopped and taken into custody when a bag of cocaine is found in his trunk.
When a man with multiple rat bites is thrown from a moving car, Danny works the case to find out why and who was trying to send a message.

Before a Hasidic Grand Rebbe passes away, he chooses his youngest son to succeed him. But when the new appointee dies suddenly, Danny investigates the oldest son and others within the Hasidic community.
When a 10-year-old boy is the victim of an incident in the projects, Danny's heated approach to the case lands him in anger management class.
Erin and Danny investigate a cold case of a girl who was attacked by her rich and powerful boyfriend, who was never convicted.
When an off-duty cop tries to stop a bank robbery, he is disarmed by the 'Bonnie and Clyde' robbers who take his gun and wound an innocent bystander.
When the same tragedy occurs to people who don't appear connected, Danny must find what they have in common and who is responsible.
When a religious young woman is murdered, Danny questions her family who is shocked to learn that she had a secret relationship.
When two Wall Street brokers are killed in drug deals, Danny looks to question a wounded accomplice at the hospital but he is stopped by Linda, who won't let Danny see him until after surgery.

When Danny finds a disoriented man in a park covered in his girlfriend's blood, he finds it hard to believe that the man has no recollection of the night's events until they find a strong narcotic in his bloodstream.
When a young woman commits suicide, Danny is emotional since he promised to help her when her parents were taken from her.
As the Reagans rally together to take down the leader of the gang responsible for the murder of someone close to them, Danny looks to the gang leader's girlfriend to lead them to him.
When an armed robbery ends with the death of a police officer, Frank makes it a mission for the NYPD to bring the suspect to justice.
When a famous movie star, Russell Berke, who shadowed Danny for research on his next role, is stabbed, Danny goes to his aid but must keep the crime on the down-low due to Russell’s celebrity status.

Danny becomes the lead hostage negotiator when a prime informant in a large drug case holds Erin at gunpoint inside the courtroom. Also, when Jamie disobeys his lieutenant’s orders and gets suspended, Frank must decide on a proper punishment.
As the persecuted party awaits Ben and Hoss' return, Herber is shot and killed. Joe retaliates and shoots Herber's assassin.
Mary Wharton, an old friend of the family, comes to live on the Ponderosa with her shiftless husband.  When Ben learns Mary is the victim of domestic abuse, he sends Russ packing.
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
Outlaws capture Ben and hide him in an abandoned mine, holding him for a ransom.  The boys must come up with a plan to save him before it's too late.
Classic comedy in which Hoss first meets prospector Obie and his lazy but allegedly brilliant mongrel dog, Walter.
Ben's plans to marry Katherine Saunders are upset when her son Eden is accused of killing his former girlfriend.
Moody bounty hunter, Dev Farnum, shows up on the Ponderosa, where the Cartwrights are harboring the wife of the man he is after.
Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.
Will is having second thoughts about staying on at the Ponderosa, and outlaws hit the ranch and take him with them.
Joe and Adam protect a saloon girl, who has killed in self-defense, from an angry lynch mob.
Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
A conman heads into town and takes advantage of the Cartwrights with a fake land deal.  The conman ends up staying in Virginia city to run an orphanage.
Hoss develops amnesia after being bushwhacked and hit over the head by two outlaws and moves in with a Dutch couple.
The Cartwrights play host to Guido Borelli, a world renowed aerial acrobat who once saved Ben's life in Italy.  Borelli's troup is beset by internal strife, and is performing in Virginia City.
The Ponderosa becomes a war zone when it is invaded by a detachment of Mexican mercenaries under General Diaz.
Ben must determine who is the rightful heir to a fortune that includes water rights vital to the Ponderosa.
A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.
Team 7 sets out on their first mission.
Team 7's original mission evolves into a rescue operation after Kiri is kidnapped.
Team 7 is assigned to capture a suspect who has barricaded himself inside a bank.
An incident occurs in Hidden Leaf Village and the Byakuya Gang is suspected.
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Ten Dollar Question
programmes.d: Jim and Margaret are so tired of the family dynamics. The children will not stop tattling on each other. They offer a ten dollar review to the child that does not tattle for one week.

Bill Davis is ambivalent about taking on the responsibility of raising his niece Buffy after the death of his brother. After suggesting she attend boarding school in Switzerland, she runs away. Giles French, the Davis butler, brings her back.
Jody, Buffy's twin brother, and Cissy arrive while Bill is away. When he returns, he must make a decision as to what to do that would be best for the children.

When Bill returns from Africa bearing gifts, Cissy presents him with a hand-knitted tie. Buffy and Jody also want to give Bill a gift, and end up purchasing a horse for him from a retiring carriage driver.

Bill decides to send Cissy to a private girls' school in Connecticut, and even though she would prefer to attend high school locally, she reluctantly agrees to go, thinking Bill wants to get her out of the way.
The rival school's quarterback suddenly takes an interest in Marcia the week of the football game., and Mike is Jealous when Carol's high school sweetheart comes for a visit.
Jan thinks she' has no talent after not being chosen for a ballet recital, so the family tries to make her feel better and help her find a skill.
Mike takes the entire family on a trip to King's Island amusement park, where he is to submit plans to a client, but the a mix-up causes the blueprints to go missing at the park.
A series of misunderstandings lead the Bradys to believe that Alice and Sam are up to much more than just bowling on their upcoming Saturday night date.

Jan makes a bunch of promises to be elected "Most Popular Girl" in her class, but backs out of them after she wins the election. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol try to make plans for their second honeymoon.
A couple Mike and Carol know adopt a young boy, but the boy soon misses his two best friends--one African-American, one Asian-American. As a result, the couple decides to adopt all three boys.
Edith is crushed when Mike and Gloria make their other plans after she's prepared a special farewell dinner in their honor.
The Bunker house is the scene of many tearful good-byes when Mike and Gloria finally leave for California.
Archie spends a night wallowing in self-pity when an insurance physical reveals an ominous spot on his liver.
Archie and Edith are invited to spend a fishing weekend with Barney and Blanche at their cottage. But after a game of Monopoly, an argument between Barney and Blanche begins.
Edith's cousin Floyd abandons his nine-year-old daughter, Stephanie, on the Bunkers' doorstep.
Edith is the sole mourner at her Aunt Rose's funeral.
The Bunkers decide to keep Stephanie after her father fails to reclaim her as promised.

With the TV broken, Edith decides to buy a new one for Archie for their 30th wedding anniversary. But when the clerk won't let Edith buy a TV without Archie's signature because she's a woman, she goes to the bank for a loan.

programmes.st: There is Nothing Like the Dames
programmes.d: Things quickly go from bad to worse when Mama hosts a backyard luncheon for a ladies' social group she wants to join, and the ladies leave in a huff.
In the series finale, Vint and Naomi finally have a baby and Mama becomes a grandmother—but not before high drama.

programmes.st: Vint and the Kids Move In
programmes.d: Mama's son Vint and his two children stop by to do some laundry. But while there, Vint ends up revealing that he has gotten evicted and they need a place to stay. Mama tells them they can move in with her.

Naomi comes over and announces that she has sold her home and is going to move away. After drinking and celebrating, they return to Mama's, and Naomi ends up spending the night. Vint ends up asking Naomi to marry him.
Naomi and Vint's wedding is coming up.  While the women are having a little party, Ellen is worried that her husband Bruce is having an affair, and the family tries to tell her that he is not.

programmes.d: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.
Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

In Rhode Island, policewomen go undercover as streetwalkers to nab the man suspected of murdering three prostitutes. And a dagger-shaped letter opener is the key piece of evidence that links a priest to the grisly 1980 murder of a nun in Ohio.
Testimony about the growth of larvae in dead bodies helps convict the man who stabbed a couple to death and strangled their 4-year-old daughter in 1993.

Police reopen a rape-murder case 25 years after the crime and find enough DNA evidence to bring him to justice. And a confession made to a "Baywatch" TV star helps police solve the three-year-old riddle of a wealthy Newport Beach woman's murder.
In Missouri, a part-time missionary is convicted, 38 years later, of killing her 5-year-old stepdaughter, and the skeleton of a Michigan boy, dead for 10 years, leads police to a serial killer.

When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and it sends a mother on a decades-long crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

A kidnapper grabs 8-year-old Chad Choice from his home in Texas, then torments his parents with two ransom demands. The case goes cold until the parents receive a chilling package in the mail that contains a letter--and a skull.
A look at the case of James Allen Selby, a serial rapist who eluded police for years while attacking 11 women in five states - Oklahoma, Nevada, California, Arizona, and Colorado.

The killing of a woman in a VA goes unsolved for a quarter of a century before investigators are finally able to zero in on the likely killer. And, in 1999 detectives test the blood evidence and develop a DNA profile of a shooting death from 1980.
A woman's fall from a cliff in the Grand Canyon leads police to uncover a series of grisly murders, and investigators smoke out a killer when they find crucial DNA evidence on his cigarette butts.
Halloween in a small town is canceled indefinitely when a young girl is kidnapped and killed on her way home from a costume party.

programmes.st: In The Care Of A Killer/Deadly Lies
programmes.d: The suspicious death of 2-year-old Billy Blankenship is solved when police force his babysitter to re-enact the circumstances of his death. Then, a murder case is solved when the dead man's body is accidentally found by divers.

A serial rapist seals his own fate when he sends a taunting letter to police. And when a man is found dead in South Dakota, his head bashed in by a 50-pound rock, investigators go on a 20-year search for the killers.
College student Brad Perry shows up to work his graveyard shift at the gas station and is never seen alive again.
When 25-year-old school teacher Christy Mirack is found murdered in her apartment in 1992, there is no shortage of suspects.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo. A closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered. Detectives ask, could she be the victim of a brutal serial killer? Or was Lisa murdered by someone she knew?
As a hurricane approaches Lawndale, the town's residents spontaneously break into song, and Daria, Jane, Brittany, and Kevin are forced to brace the storm together.
When Jane's family members all come home at once, she and Trent temporarily move into Daria's house, Helen and Jake pick Jane's brain, and Daria imagines a future with Trent.
Ilana goes on a spending spree with her waitressing cash, and Abbi basks in the glow of a new relationship. Later that night, the girls bump into an old friend at a party.
Abbi and Ilana take shrooms and have an eventful trip.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program A Good Van Is Hard to Find
programmes.d: Brian and Steve fight over laundry responsibilities, and Sarah realizes that vans make people creepy.
Laura and Sarah host dueling Holocaust memorials, and Brian and Steve try to prank Officer Jay.
Adam and Ders struggle to get back into the dating game, and Jillian and Blake discover that co-parenting a cat is more responsibility than they can handle.
After a special adult video the guys order goes missing, they must embark on a quest to find the package before it's too late.
When a social media expert comes to the office, the guys compete to hone their personal brands.
As 420 approaches, Blake meets a woman online, but Adam and Ders are convinced that he's being catfished.
After the guys run into a former coworker who was transferred to another branch of TelAmeriCorp, they try to get jobs there.
The guys get busted for smoking pot and attend a Narcotics Anonymous meeting, where Blake runs into an old friend and Ders makes a scary new one.
Jordan and Keegan engage in an epic flicker match, and a flash mob goes terribly wrong.
President Obama doesn't get special treatment, and a young Forest Whitaker terrifies his babysitter.
Two friends encounter a racist dog in the park, the flamboyant players of the East/West Collegiate Bowl introduce themselves, and a dubstep track derails moving day.
A young Barack Obama discovers how inspirational a party can be, and two hitmen get sidetracked.
Episode 2 includes Plate Frisbee, Most Wanted, They're Coming to Take Me Away, Huh Huh, and Patients Patients, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.

Beavis & Butthead features two lunkheaded teenagers who dress in heavy-metal T-shirts, love stuff that is "cool," hate stuff that "sucks," and spend most of their time sitting on a couch making fun of music videos.
Episode 10 includes Babysitting, Buttniks, and Bungholio: Lord of the Harvest.
Episode 2 includes Party, What's the Deal, Wet Behind the Rears, and Animation Sucks.
Episode 3 includes Candy Sale, Here Comes the Bride's Butt, Pregnant Pause, and Oil Change.
Nathan discovers a snafu in his plan to offer valet services at a nail salon and embarks on a mission to prove that people enjoy his company.
Nathan organizes a death-defying stunt in an attempt to turn a regular guy into a national hero.
Sam and Tim decide to play dirty after Doner starts stealing their clients.
After a fortuitous accident at a fundraiser, Sam and Tim find themselves reeling in a big fish of a client: Little Caesars.
The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.

A victim of the Salem witch trials curses the town, one woman changes the way people celebrate Halloween, and Vlad the Impaler inspires the novel "Dracula." Featuring Seth Rogen, Allison Tolman, Jorma Taccone and Joel McHale.
Nathan tries to get a haunted house deemed "too scary" and overcomes his fear of the opposite sex by creating a fake reality show.
Things get spooky when the guys discover a former employee may be haunting the office.
When Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes a monthly visit, she brings a mysterious pet fish for Stan.
Korn comes to South Park for a Halloween concert and helps the boys solve a spooky pirate ghost mystery.
Cartman decides to seek friendship using the Internet and finds an older man who is more than willing to be his friend...and more.
The BAU is called to investigate a series of D.C. homicides where cryptic messages are found inside the mouths of each victim. (TV-14 L, V)
When successful businessmen in Detroit are targeted by an anger-driven power-assertive Unsub, the BAU is called in to investigate. (TV-14 D, L , V)

Immediately following the Ecstacy case in New York City, the Replicator has hacked into Garcia's computer system, on which he posts photographs of each of the team members in New York and his "Zugzwang" calling card.

When a passenger jet crashes in Colorado, the BAU team is called to build a profile around the suspicious circumstances. Also, the case hits close to home for Kate, who is reminded of a family tragedy.
The BAU continues its murder investigation in Texas, and clues uncover a deep web of corruption that could be the motive for the killings.

When Reid discovers former FBI Special Agent Owen Quinn (James Urbaniak) locked inside a storage unit, the BAU questions the credibility of Quinn's bizarre accounts of searching for an UnSub that he named 'The Strangler'. (TV-14 L, V)

Caught in an impossible scenario, Reid must square off with an old nemesis, and Derek Morgan (guest star Shemar Moore) comes to the team with a lead that might help catch Mr. Scratch, the elusive fugitive that has been tormenting the team all season.

The BAU team investigates a series of murders in Bakersfield, Calif., which have left the victims unidentifiable. Also, the team welcomes new agent Kate Callahan into the BAU fold, who assists them in their efforts in solving the cases.

When the BAU is called to Kansas City to investigate a series of murders, a tense reunion ensues between Blake and her father, a retired police captain, and her brother, a detective, who must work together to help solve the crime.

The BAU searches for an UnSub who is purposely disfiguring victims. Also, Rossi has an awkward reunion with his ex-wife, Hayden Montgomery, who kept his daughter, Joy, a secret from him for nearly 30 years. Sheryl Lee Ralph guest stars.
Prentiss and The BAU team fly to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes in the middle of the night.
When brides-to-be in Savannah are killed on the eve of their nuptials, the BAU suspects a jilted UnSub is at work. Michael Irvin, Ashley Fink, and Mancow Muller guest star.
When a time capsule in a small Colorado town is opened 25 years later and contains a gruesome discovery, the BAU investigates that crime and a possible link to the death of a local police officer.

When the mummified remains of numerous victims are found in the walls of an elderly couple's remote South Carolina home, Rossi, J.J. and Simmons are dispatched to track down a trail of clues that date back over 20 years.
When Reid fears his mother has been abducted, he asks the BAU to investigate while he's stuck in prison. (TV-14 L, V)
When Kate's niece Meg and her best friend are kidnapped, the BAU suspects an online predator engaged in sex trafficking.

The BAU goes to Morgan's old neighbourhood in urban Chicago in search of an UnSub targeting middle-aged men, and a clue leads Morgan to believe that they are after someone connected to the man who molested him as a child.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Cameos and Show Group auditions push the new girls and vets to their limits. Melissa Rycroft tries to save a DCC that's hanging by a thread and there is a shocking outcome from a Kelli office visit.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Emotions are supercharged as Kelli & Judy make a lot of tough cuts to keep up the quality of the team.  Melissa Rycroft offers invaluable field experience.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli finally announces the squad. Injuries threaten the opening of Cowboys training camp.  Game Day chaos endangers a flawless performance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Hundreds of beautiful and talented hopefuls arrive to try out for the best cheerleading team in the world, while many of the returning girls are looking for redemption. New judges increase the pressure of moving on to Finals.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Veterans fight for their jobs as new girls try to live their dreams and make DCC Training Camp.  Standing in their way is; panel Interviews, solos, an exhausting dance combination and a room full of very tough judges.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The new candidates' eyes are opened as they get a taste of what it is to be a DCC.  As girls struggle to learn the dances, the reality of being "Big Time", sets in.  Melissa Rycroft meets the new girls for the first time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With the first cut looming, the girls must push their dance skills to the limit. Melissa Rycroft works to bring out showmanship. Extra stress is added on Makeover day as the girls try to get the DCC look.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: A new choreographer shakes things up. The girls better start looking good because uniform fittings and the Belk fashion show are on the agenda.  Surprises continue when two-time Grammy winner Kacey Musgraves, stops by rehearsal.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Melissa Rycroft makes a house call to help Yuko.  Kitty Carter rocks a few of the candidate's worlds.  Cameos give Kelli & Judy a fresh perspective on the girls. At Show Group auditions, the girls let it all hang out.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kellie Pickler comes to a rehearsal to share her experience and motivate the girls as Training Camp is coming to an end. Melissa Rycroft makes Kelsey aware of a big mistake.  Candace Romo helps with a big night of cuts.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Squad announcement is bittersweet as some favorites go home.  The team has their first appearance at the Star Ribbon cutting.  Game Day is when dreams come true!

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Hundreds of beautiful and talented women converge on AT&T Stadium to start the hardest audition process in professional sports, trying out for a coveted spot on the most famous NFL cheerleading squad in the world, the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With the field narrowed down to 119 women, the pressure is on.  They must quickly learn a power pom routine and the famous kickline in order to perform it an hour later before the judges.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The veterans finally enter the audition process. Now all 83 women are judged head to head during a panel interview, a solo dance performance and on their appearance on the football field as seen and the big screen.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: 44 women begin the very first training camp at the new 1 billion dollar Cowboys' facility, The Star.  At the First Meeting, Kelli lays down the law and makes it clear that eight women will be sent home this summer.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: First, the ladies need to have the "classic look" of a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Kelli's hair and make-up transformations are legendary.  The ladies are also assessed through a new state of the art fitness test, "Styku".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli media trains the rookie candidates to determine who best represents the DCC at press events.  NBC news anchor, Meredith Land tests their on-camera interview skills.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Personality is critical when representing the DCC brand.  Kelli takes the women on location to see how they interact during a public appearance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Katy Perry's choreographer, Nick Florez, stops by to offer some performance advice to the ladies.  A day that each cheerleader never forgets.  The first time they wear the DCC uniform to pose for their cameo photos.
Angelique shows Barnabas a terrifying vision and Quentin attempts voodoo on Barnabas.
After Jenny hears Quentin's music, she escapes and searches for him with a large knife.
Jenny stabs Quentin and leaves him to die. Barnabas later finds Dirk leaning over the body.
Barnabas summons Angelique to save Quentin. She causes him to rise as a zombie.
Rachel wakes from a nightmare to find Quentin, as a zombie, rocking by her bed.
After a ritual, Quentin returns to his coffin, but he later rises and abducts Rachel.
Barnabas, Magda and Sandor perform a ceremony to make Quentin's spirit return to his body.
Gregory Trask tells Judith that Jamison Collins is possessed by Quentin's spirit.
After Judith and Barnabas discover that Jamison and Quentin are normal again, Jamison disappears.
Rachel tells Barnabas that she attended Trask's school. Barnabas bites Trask's daughter, Charity.
Nora Collins sees a vision of her absent mother, Laura, in the flames of the fireplace.
Nora sneaks out of Collinwood to search for her mother in the woods.
Laura returns to Collinwood. Quentin sees her and claims that he saw her die in Alexandria.
Laura refuses her husband Edward's bribe of payment to leave town permanently.
Laura causes Quentin to experience pain. Angelique agrees to revive him if Barnabas will marry her.
Minerva Trask arrives to take Rachel and the children back to Worthington Hall.
At school, Trask reprimands Jamison by locking him in a closet and threatens more severe punishment.
Trask refuses to return Jamison and Nora to Laura. That night, the school catches on fire.
Quentin attempts to destroy Laura by pouring sand into an urn containing her supernatural power.
In an attempt to save herself from destruction, Laura prays to Ra to take possession of Dirk.
Laura tells Jamison that Quentin is trying to kill her. Barnabas is shocked at the sight of Laura.
Barnabas and Charity find a portrait of Jeremiah Collins' first wife, who looks like Laura Collins.
Barnabas sends Sandor to find Laura's grave. Edward tells Barnabas what he knows of Laura's history.
Laura confesses she has returned to Collinwood to take custody of her children Jamison and Nora.
Barnabas uses an incantation from the Egyptian Book of the Dead to conjure up the spirit of Laura.
Quentin and Barnabas decide to try to destroy Laura. Jenny is ordered by Laura to kill Quentin.
Jenny meets Barnabas at the Old House and Quentin takes a pistol to search for her.
Jenny's sister Magda is shocked to discover that Jenny has been locked away at Collinwood.
Magda threatens to curse Quentin. Jenny tells Judith that she saw Barnabas in a coffin.
Jenny prepares to kill Quentin and Beth after overhearing them declare their love for each other.
After Quentin accidentally kills Jenny, Magda curses him for the rest of his life.
Magda describes the history of the curse to Quentin and tells him that it will begin that night.
At sunset, Magda recites an incantation and Quentin is struck by pain as the full moon rises.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Rasta Finale

programmes.t: Flavor of Love: In Flav We Trust

When a hit-and-run patient mysteriously dies in the hospital, Dr. Sloan and his interns, Jack and Amanda, put their amateur crime solving abilities to the test.
A mobster's gun moll fakes her way past hospital security guards, and Dr. Sloan almost becomes her next victim! Attractive and smart, no one suspected Amy Westin's true identity.

Tonight, of all nights, Murphy's Law is definitely operating at its worst! After finally finagling all the details to put together a money-raising telethon for the hospital, Dr. Sloan loses his cool when the host of the show is murdered - on the air!
A late night call for help sends Dr. Sloan racing to the rescue! Ninety-two-year-old millionaire Jonathan Nash fears for his life.
A supposed 'ticket to heaven' leads to a trail of greedy scam artists and gamblers! Dying of a gunshot wounds, a man gives Dr. Sloan a winning lottery ticket.

A 'perfect cover' becomes a foul frame-up when Steve Sloan is accused of murder! Staging various crimes in their off-hours with perfect success, four corrupt police officers think they have it made - until one of them commits a homicide.

A box of mutilated flowers and slashed photos drives pop-singer Shanda into a state of shock. After she collapses and her road tour grinds to a halt, Dr. Mark Sloan takes pity on Shanda and embarks on a search to find her mysterious stalker.

Still groggy from a visit to the dentist, Dr. Sloan is mystified when a noted fund-raiser dies while visiting his home. Adding to the confusion, the body mysteriously disappears before the police get there!
Dr. Sloan's free tickets to a friend's magic show become an invitation to murder when the magician mysteriously dies on stage in the middle of his escape act!

A romance in bloom is nipped in the bud when Steve's new girlfriend is charged with murder. An instructor of modern dance, Cindy is shocked to learn she's being charged with killing one of the owners of the studio where she works.
A cruel collage prank comes back to haunt four young women in later life. Although Amanda had almost forgotten it, a recent letter brings back the unpleasant memory.
Surprise, surprise! While investigating the murder of a call-girl, Dr. Sloan is caught in the middle of a vice raid!

Dr. Sloan becomes involved in more than politics when he accepts an invitation to attend an election campaign party. A face in a crowd of well-wishers awakens old memories for Mayor Ridgeway's wife, Lauren, with murderous results.

Always trying to help out a friend, Jack Stewart offers his support when a con-man acquaintance tries to straighten out his life. Instead, Jack's entwined in a mysterious fatal car accident investigation involving a posh health spa.
A tense situation erupts into a hotbed of chaos! While awaiting treatment from Dr. Sloan, convicted criminal John Dunbar unexpectedly jumps his guards and seizes a gun.

A devastating earthquake causes widespread damage and Dr. Sloan's hospital goes on emergency power. After the tremors stop, Mark's friend Martin Garfield is found dead in the ruins of his mansion nearby. Was it the earthquake or murder?

Harry goes crazy at anything on wheels; shadows drive Brooks crazy.
Cesar tries to help a boxer named Coach before he is put down for biting someone; Sueki turns her nose up at leads.
Cesar tries to help Slick a fear-ridden dog who was rescued after living in a crate for 15 hours a day and Pepper, another rescue dog with issues.
Ava, a small mixed-breed spins constantly; Gus, a large dog who greets people by throwing its body at them.
Churchill is usually a well-mannered dog, but around other animals he's a monster, and lovable pit bull Maya can be a handful.
Cesar takes the spoiled Bubba down a notch; discover why German shepherd Garret never stops chasing his tail.
Emily, the pit bull, is sent to doggie boot camp because she is so quick to attack other dogs that her owners can no longer walk her.
A rescued mastiff likes to chew everything and barks incessantly; Paris is a temperamental, long-haired Chihuahua.
A dog trained to sniff out contraband cell phones in prisons is unable to do his job due to his skittish nature; a dog is terrified of hot air balloons.
A Dogo Argentino with canine aggression; a terrier/corgi mix who becomes aggressive when faced with traveling.
Mufasa, a South African boerboel, became aggressive after being pinned down by another dog; Tucker, a teacup poodle's behavior became more aggressive.
A couple with three unruly dogs, one with aggression issues; a poodle who fears the back door since running into the screen door; a Weimaraner who is territorial and aggressive.
A dog with an abusive past fears men; a Border Collie mix refuses to leave his chair and is afraid of leashes.
Aggressive bulldog Hugo is sent to canine rehab; Crusty must overcome his dominance issues if he's ever going to enjoy walks.
Two Jack Russell terriers, Ruby and Jinx, show how dogs communicate through energy and body language.
Stella is a bulldog mascot for a dog-friendly café; a German shepherd who barks too loud, and two aggressive miniature pinschers.
At an army base, Cesar helps an Australian shepherd scared of men in uniform and a Shetland shepherd who barks non-stop when planes fly overhead.
Cesar helps two former gang members through Homeboy Industries, an outreach program designed to break the cycle of gang violence but who have problem dogs at home.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.
Achoo, achoo! What's that sound? Benny the Bull has the sneezes. It's Doctor Dora to the rescue as she sets off for Benny's barn for a house call.
Byron Sully, an enigmatic man whose closest companions are the Indians and a wolf, becomes Mike's friend as she struggles for acceptance.
Dr. Quinn immediately takes action to stop the spread of a deadly epidemic.

Mike's stoic, disapproving Bostonian mother, Elizabeth, who, after years of estrangement, visits her daughter in Colorado Springs but finds her unconventional life on the frontier difficult to accept.
When a starving orphaned immigrant takes desperate measures to feed his siblings, the only thing standing between him and a noose is Kid Cole, the new sheriff.
Loren, the unforgiving father-in-law, threatens to take back Sully's homestead.
Michaela worries when Charlotte's husband, Ethan Cooper, comes back to the family he abandoned, convincing almost everyone of his newfound ways.
When the town's water supply is tainted with mercury by a wealthy mining baron, many people become sick and Dr. Mike threatens the miner to clean it up or have his land taken away.
When Doc Eli, a medicine-show man, arrives in town professing to have created the perfect bottled elixir, Mike sets out to call his bluff, especially when her children's health becomes jeopardized.
A wandering cowboy abandons his baby boy and leaves him in Dr. Mike's care.
Progress comes to Colorado Springs, and Sully pays the price.
When Cheyenne medicine man Cloud Dancing is wounded by General Custer, who intends to hang him, Sully and Dr. Mike join forces to help him escape.
As Dr. Mike's birthday approaches, the kids decide to do something about her unmarried status
Matthew and Michaela are at odds over his future when he sets out to prove to others -- and to himself -- that he's a grown man ready to take on life -- and decides to marry Ingrid.
Influenced by the pulp romance novels she loves, Colleen develops her first crush -- on Sully -- and schemes a way for him to rescue her from danger.
Dr. Mike faces the most difficult challenge of her career when she is forced to operate on Brian after he suffers a brain injury.
Dr. Mike discovers Hank's dark secret -- an illegitimate son.

In Seattle, Jeff and Blake learn the woman who died in the plane crash with Peter DeVilbis cannot be positively identified, but the ring she was wearing is indeed Fallon's wedding band. Back in Denver, Fallon's moving funeral is held.

Blake visits Dominique at La Mirage to discuss her recent revelation. She tells Blake that her mother was a long-time mistress of his father and has evidence to prove it. At Alexis' trial, a neighbor offers powerful evidence that incriminates Alexis.

On the witness stand, Steven testified he saw Alexis push Mark to his death. Jeff sees other women in an attempt to forget Fallon but remains obsessed with his ex-wife. Alexis takes the stand and testifies.

Adam and Dex vow to prove Alexis' innocence and begin a determined campaign. The woman who testified she had seen Alexis on the terrace with Mark had hosted a party that evening and snapped photographs.
Amanda insists Alexis acknowledge their relationship and begs her to reveal her father's identity. Alexis tells her it was simply an anonymous ski instructor in Gstaad. Steven and Alexis reconcile.
Blake offers to help Amanda find her father. Claudia goes out with Dean to dinner, while Steven rejects Luke. Jeff ends up sleeping with Nicole. Dominique goes to Istanbul to meet with Rashid Ahmed.

Krystle goes into premature labor and delivers a baby girl, who suffers from respiratory problems. She names the child Kristina after a friend who once saved her life. Claudia is uneasy when Steven accompanies Luke on a business trip.

Upon learning that he may be Amanda's father, Blake resolves to ask Amanda to take a blood test. Nicole tells Jeff there's a chance Peter DeVilbis may have been with another woman at the time of the crash.

Blake buys back his racehorse Allegre from owner Daniel Reece, who sends Krystle a gift. Furious, she demands to know how he dared approach her after what happened with her sister, Iris. Amanda learns she is Blake's daughter.

Krystle reconciles with Daniel, who reveals that his break-up with her sister was amicable. Claudia moves into La Mirage. Krystle confides to Steven that Daniel is Sammy Jo's father and therefore little Danny's grandfather.

Claudia rebuffs Steven's conciliatory attempts. Tension between Dex and Amanda continues to mount. On his deathbed, Tom Carrington makes amends with Blake, and in a final dramatic gesture, has his will changed.

Krystle begins working with Daniel. Blake is adamantly opposed and exchanges harsh words with Reece. Dex is furious with Alexis for traveling to Sumatra to see Blake's father. Alexis learns from Amanda about Dex's experience with Daniel in Vietnam.

Krystle launches her new business with the purchase of an Arabian horse. Sexual tension between Steven and Luke mounts. Jeff and Nikki return from Bolivia with the news of their marriage and they move into the mansion.

Blake returns triumphant from his negotiations with the Chinese. Alexis vows to buy into the venture. Krystle, uncomfortable with Daniel's increasing attention, avoids him. Blake invites Amanda to accompany him on a business trip to Acapulco.

Alexis attempts to persuade the head of the Chinese delegation to hire Colbyco. Blake is surprised to learn Lady Ashley is an Acapulco. Amanda has a romantic fling with Prince Michael of Moldavia. Krystle makes a surprise visit to Daniel.

Amanda spends the night with Prince Michael and then is heartsick to learn he is engaged. Dex persuades the Chinese delegation to use his company instead of Blake's for an important drilling job. Claudia finally accepts Adam's advances.

Tensions between Krystle and Blake mount as their suspicions of one another grow. Claudia regrets sleeping with Adam. Dominique derails Alexis' attempt to buy out her company but is unable to stop Brady's divorce proceedings.
The team suddenly realizes that the twin daughters of a murdered couple are missing.
A man who volunteered in South America fails to return home.
A father is killed in a car accident and his infant son mysteriously disappears from the accident.
Jess and Nicole investigate when a busload of people goes missing during a casino tour; the bus disappears on its way from Philadelphia to Atlantic City.

The tensions in Zora and Isaiah's relationship come to a head at the Cotillion; Lady Mae makes an overture of peace to Mavis and the result is a revelation that sends Mae into a tailspin.
The Bishop and Lady Mae's crumbling marriage threatens to destroy the Greenleaf family, then a two-million dollar IRS tax bill arrives at Calvary, putting the church in danger.
Grace takes Rochelle up on her offer to help start a legal defense fund; Bishop and Lady Mae ask if parishioner Clara Jackson's Powerball winnings can assist with their IRS bill.
The Bishop sends Lady Mae into a tailspin when he surprises her with divorce papers; Grace gives a newspaper interview in Mae's place, while deploying Darius to investigate Rochelle.
Lady Mae visits world-famous Pastor Maxine Patterson and endures the Bishop's final attempt to win her back at a Round Table party; Connie asks if Grace is interested in running Calvary.
The Bishop and Lady Mae make alternate plans after Clara denies them the check for the IRS bill; Grace tends to Sophia when a medical emergency sends her daughter to the hospital.
Maxine Patterson visits Calvary during the same weekend that Lady Mae and the Bishop announce their divorce to the congregation; Grace and Rochelle find a case for their legal defense fund.

When Thorfinn's bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he's always wanted.
When Sam and Jay invite their nosy neighbors to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.
On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.
Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother, Sheryl (Rachael Harris), died to see if she's now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret he overheard Sam and Jay discussing to his fellow ghosts.
When Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they're shocked to discover that she's communicating with someone they know on a dating app.
Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.st: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
programmes.d: A séance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.
Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys' house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.
When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

Alberta's past expertise comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into complications during their Woodstone whiskey-tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac's past.
Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), ignoring Hetty's warning not to get too close to "the help." Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica (Nichole Sakura), the ghost who lives in Freddie's car.

Personality quirks begin to fray nerves after best friends Richie, Ralph, and Potsie rent an apartment together.
Richie and Fonzie must think fast to outwit a tough housemother after they're caught past curfew in the college girls' dormitory.

Squiggy and Lenny move into the girls' building, making them all neighbors.
Shirley wants to buy a car but needs half of Laverne's money to afford it. Laverne refuses to help buy the car and Shirley reveals Laverne's secret fear: she's scared to drive.
Shirley talks Laverne into volunteering with her at the hospital.

programmes.d: Lenny and Squiggy vanish without a trace.

The girls have trouble fitting in at a bridal shower.
Laverne tries to remember the events of a wild night when she wakes up with morning sickness and fears she may be pregnant.
The girls decide to start a new career in modeling.
Laverne gets arrested for stealing.

Mindy is convinced that she has unleashed the swingingest single ever after she persuades Mork that it would inprove their relationship if each began dating new people and he turns into the hilarious new king of Boulder's social scene.

When Mindy eats one of Mork's gourmet delights, she turns into a wacky Orkan herself, sending her family reunion into a rollicking tizzy and treating pompous old Uncle Dave (special guest star Jonathan Winters) to a bizarre evening he won't forget.

The joyous visit by everyone's favorite, Grandma Cora, turns to gloom when she gets mugged in the park, but Mork turns the dastardly deed into a hilarious caper when he and Grandma join forces to even the score.

programmes.st: I Heard It Through The Morkvine
programmes.d: Mork, who doesn't understand why people gossip, reveals some hilarious inside scoops when he shows and tells all about his friends while subbing for Mindy as host of a local TV show called Rumor Has It.

When Mindy has to work long hours on a new TV call-in show, Mork has to help with the housework. But when his comedic cleaning efforts turn the apartment into a disaster area, he calls up Mindy, on the air, for a new set of instructions.
Mr. Bickley's 50th birthday celebration turns into a crazy exchange of everybody's deepest secrets, but Mindy waits until the group leaves to tell Mork somthing she's wanted to say for years.

Mindy is the beautiful bride and Mork is the outrageously funny groom - who may not be able to fit into his tuxedo if he can't convince Orson to approve the marriage and undo his transformation of Mork into an English sheep dog.

Richie must choose either a 5-year Hollywood contract or college in Milwaukee while the Fonz accepts the California Kid's challenge to perform a dangerous water ski jump...over a shark!
Fonzie is furious with his rebellious cousin, Chachi Arcola, after Chachi cheats on a school test using answers stolen from a tutoring session with Joanie Cunningham.
To prove to his college journalism professor that he has what it takes to be a good investigative reporter, Richie gets down and dirty to expose who's behind an illegal garbage collection scheme.
Snobby Cynthia Holmes schemes with her obnoxious cousin, Skippy, to make the Fonz look foolish at a country club soirée.
Richie, Ralph, and Potsie endure the harassment of "hell week" to prove themselves worthy to enter their college fraternity, Phi Kappa Nu.

Sophomore Joanie Cunningham gets basic back-seat defense tips from Richie and Fonzie before her first "car date" with a senior boy, and then cramps her older brother's style when she and her date show up at his college "make-out" party.
What begins as a humorous escapade with a motorcycle turns into a tragic vigil for the Cunninghams and their friends.

Jason and Maggie decide they want to break their mutual contract regarding their work-life balance.
When Mike takes a newspaper route to earn extra money, he tries to make Ben deliver the papers.

The love triangle between Mike, Kate, and David becomes even more complicated after Mike expresses feelings.

When Ben asks for permission to have an ear pierced, Jason and Maggie argue over who gets the final word.
When Mike takes Kate for a Valentine's Day dinner, he's shocked to discover their waitress is his ex-fiancé.
Mike suddenly finds himself back at Dewey High School - only this time he's a student, not a teacher.
Klink reluctantly falls in with two other Kommandants plotting against Burkhalter. Burkhalter finds out. Now Hogan must step in before Stalag 13 loses Klink the military way - by firing squad.

programmes.st: That's No Lady, That's My Spy

programmes.st: The Rise And Fall Of Sergeant Schultz

The location of a chemical plant is the prize when Hogan gets Carter to become a traitor.
Rusted-out plumbing collapses the emergency tunnel just as Hogan needs to get four Underground leaders out of Germany, so he creates a health spa.

programmes.st: The Prince From The Phone Company

Hogan sneaks out of camp to a local German Hofbrau House to get the details of a nearby German army unit.

The Heroes have to figure how to get a new type of rocket back to England.
Hogan talks Klink into building an officers' club, whereby a boat can be built to sail away with an escaped British POW and the German gunsight he snagged while escaping.

Hogan wants Klink to forget about a promotion so he plays cupid for him and General Burkhalter's sister.
A Gestapo female operative tries to lure secrets out of Sergeant Schultz.
Hogan's latest underground contacts are secretly German spies.

programmes.st: What Time Does the Balloon Go Up?

With Major Hochstetter in the camp, Hogan has extra trouble trying to smuggle out a bomber crew especially after they are moved from their usual barracks.
Hogan has to help three German scientists escape from Stalag 13 and get to London.
Newkirk sneaks a beautiful woman into camp who turns out to be a Gestapo agent.
