The prisoners create an elaborate underground ruse to fool a German spy that has been placed in their ranks.

programmes.st: Man's Best Friend Is Not His Dog
programmes.d: Hogan's crew is chasing a dog around after it buries a bone that contains negatives of a new German tank.
Hogan has to save Klink when his account books at Stalag 13 aren't quite correct.
Hogan convinces Klink and the Gestapo that the war is over so that they will release some prisoners.
Marya, the White Russian, uses Schultz to impersonate Goering just as Hogan is trying to save a trainload of stolen art.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.

Lucy is jealous after Ricky dances with Angela Randall, an up-and-coming British actress. She gets Ricky away from her by going to the country estate of Sir Clive Richardson, a prominent English film producer, for a fox hunt he is hosting.

The Ricardos and Mertzes prepare to leave London for Paris, Lucy realizes that they will not have time to visit her ancestral land of Scotland. She was looking forward to seeking out members of the McGillicuddy clan, her distant relatives.
Equipped with an English-French dictionary, Lucy sets out to explore Paris and discover an artist whose paintings will become very valuable – she knows she has "the eye."

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Lucy goes on a hunger strike in order to get Ricky to buy an expensive dress from a famous French designer. He finally gives in but returns the dress when he discovers that Ethel smuggled her food while on the strike.

Fred, managing Ricky's band while on European tour, routes the musicians to Locarno instead of Lucerne. Ricky is distraught and Lucy suggests a hike in the Alps with the Mertzes to take his mind off his problems.

Fred Mertz, managing Ricky's European band tour, is very concerned over the expense incurred when he misrouted Ricky's band so he books second-class train passage for the overnight trip to Florence and a fourth-class hotel for their stay.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, "Bitter Grapes".

The Ricardos and Mertzes are leaving Genoa for Nice when Lucy decides they should all go by bicycle because they can't see enough of the countries from the train. Ricky and the Mertzes agree under protest and after an exhausting day of pedaling.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
The Ricardos and Mertzes need to return to the United States by plane instead of ship creating problems for Lucy who has bought, among other souvenirs, a 30-pound cheese.

Ricky is opening a new night spot, the Club Babalu, and wants Bob Hope to appear at the grand opening. Lucy fears Hope won't because of her widespread reputation for causing chaos, and wants to reassure him that this time she's butting out.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.
Orson Welles is scheduled to perform for a benefit in Ricky's club. Ricky is worried that Lucy will foul things up if she is around so he decides to send her off to Florida.

Little Ricky is scheduled to play the drums in his first music school recital. Although his parents and the Mertzes are overcome with nervousness, Little Ricky seems calm until his big moment arrives, then goes to pieces.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Lucy has misplaced her and Ethel's train tickets to Florida and they must share a ride with strange Mrs. Grundy. Mrs Grundy's odd behavior becomes more troubling to Lucy and Ethel when they learn that an escaped hatchet murderess matches her description.

While on vacation in Florida, Lucy and Ethel go on a shopping spree and spend a whopping $140! To make sure that their wives don't repeat their spree Ricky and Fred take the ladies on their next fishing trip.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

Ricky and Fred are scheduled to judge a beauty contest but Lucy and Ethel plan for them to miss it. The four go out on a little cruise before the contest and Lucy has arranged for the boat's gas tank to be only half-filled.

The Ricardos and the Mertzes are cast in Little Ricky's school play when it runs short of cast members. Ricky plays a hollow tree, Lucy is the wicked witch, Fred plays the friendly frog, and Ethel is transformed in to the fairy princess.

Ricky insults Lucy's taste in hats so, as a joke, Lucy puts a loving cap trophy on her head that Ricky plans to present to champion jockey Johnny Longden at a National Turf Association dinner later that night. The trophy gets stuck on Lucy's head.

Little Ricky is turning 5 years old and Lucy had a party planned for Saturday, but Caroline Appleby is throwing a birthday party for her son Stevie on the same day. Neither mother is willing to change the date of their party.

Lucy and Ricky are determined to get rid of the puppy their son has brought home. They have a hard time overcoming Little Ricky’s arguments that it’s a welcome addition to a home that already boasts a parakeet, a frog, a lizard, a turtle and a goldfish.

programmes.st: Lucy Wants To Move To The Country
programmes.d: Lucy has become tired of living in the city and drops some none-too-subtle hints to Ricky that it would be nice to move to the country. Unbeknownst to her Ricky has already placed a comfortable deposit on a house in Westport, Connecticutt.

The Ricardos are anxious about their move to the country. Reality really sets in when Fred shows their apartment to a young couple. The Taylors will take the apartment but need to move in immediately.

The Ricardos get settled in their country home after all those years in a New York apartment and immediately begin to miss their old friends, Fred and Ethel. Lucy and Ricky decide to surprise the Mertzes with a visit.

programmes.st: Lucy Gets Chummy With The Neighbors
programmes.d: Wanting to replace their old furniture, Lucy gets an allowance of $500 from Ricky. Lucy goes overboard when she shops with their new neighbor Betty Ramsey, spending over three thousand dollars!

Although there are perks to living in their new country home, like House & Garden wanting to do a spread on them, the Ricardos find that it is expensive in Connecticut. Lucy decides to raise chickens and sell eggs as a moneymaking sideline.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, impatient with their egg selling business, decide that they must trade in their 500 chicks for 200 egg laying hens. However, after a couple of weeks, these hens don't yield many eggs at all.
The artists are tasked with designing art using nails, and military personnel brings their loved ones as they sit for portraits in a high-pressure Elimination Tattoo.
The remaining four artists must survive a tattoo marathon, and the contestants are given the chance to redo their previously botched tattoos to secure a spot in the finale.
Eliminated artists return to confront one another, and for the first time ever, the final three artists tattoo live for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.
The battle for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master begins as new artists are thrown into the fire in an intense Flash Challenge, and the first veteran artist returns.
Egos collide when the artists are forced to get their hands dirty in a team Flash Challenge, and another veteran artist returns to clean up the competition.
Creativity is tested in a salty Flash Challenge, the artists transform their canvases into comic-book characters, and another veteran artist returns.
Forensics expert Adrian Gardner assesses the artists' fingerprint tattoos in the Flash Challenge, and a veteran artist's return sparks old rivalries.
The artists team up to transform contortionists using body paint, and a veteran artist returns to add a new-school twist to an old subject.
New alliances are formed during a high-pressure Flash Challenge, and a veteran artist joins forces with the new artists in an effort to take down a common enemy.
Alliances are broken during a white-knuckled Flash Challenge, a veteran artist returns, and the artists must design political portraits in the Elimination Tattoo.
The artists pair up in a tedious Flash Challenge, the final veteran artist returns, and canvases sit for traditional Japanese dragon-themed tattoos.
The remaining artists work in pairs to execute cohesive large-scale back pieces, and the judges introduce a surprise twist that sends two more artists packing.
The six remaining artists work in an assembly line for an American traditional-style Elimination Tattoo, and the artists must put one of their teammates up for elimination.
The pressure is on when the artists must ink the ultimate in-your-face tattoo, and regretful canvases task the artists with covering up symbols of hate.
The tables are turned when the new artists call the shots in the Elimination Tattoo, and the battle for a spot in the finale is more intense than ever.
The master canvases are revealed, and America helps crown a new Ink Master.
Inuyasha slices through the Panthers' barrier with his red Tetsusaiga, and Inuyasha and Koga make their way into the castle town.

programmes.st: The Panther Tribe and the Two Swords of the Fang
programmes.d: The Panther King, the general of the Panther Tribe, begins to move with the power of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha and Sesshomaru attack the mummy.
Sango is asked to slay a demon by a young lord named Kuranosuke, who fell in love with her six years ago. Kuranosuke has looks, status, and wealth.
The Tetsusaiga is equipped with a technique that can break through barriers. Jaken plans to steal it from Inuyasha, but his plans continually fail.
Naraku tells Sesshomaru that he'll give Rin back if he kills Inuyasha, but Sesshomaru charges into Naraku's castle instead.
Naraku is trying to absorb Sesshomaru so that he can get the powers of a complete demon. But Inuyasha breaks through his barrier and interferes.
Kagome returns to the present day. She is busy preparing for a mock exam two days later.

programmes.st: The Female Wolf-Demon and the Lunar Rainbow Promise
programmes.d: Ayame, a female demon wolf, appears before Koga and tells him that she is his fiancée. But Koga is madly in love with Kagome.
Ayame brought Koga to stop her comrades' fighting. But she has no intention of returning to Koga.

programmes.st: The Evil Within Demon's Head Castle
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet an old lady who's a seemingly fake purifier.
Inuyasha fights the lord of Ogre Castle. Sanfo hears that Miroku has gone to the basement with the princess, and goes after him with the old purifier.
Kikyo looks for Naraku. She meets Kansuke, an old bandit. Kansuke has a serious illness and is trying to find a place to die.

programmes.st: The Three Sprites of the Monkey God
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang accept a job to get rid of monkeys who are destroying fields. They meet three monkeys, Gon, Bun, and Ken.

programmes.st: Nursing Battle of the Rival Lovers
programmes.d: Kagome catches a cold and returns to the present day. Inuyasha is worried about her. He gathers lots of nutritious food.
Kagome's younger brother, Sota, has fallen in love. He has fallen in love with Hitomi, one of his classmates.

programmes.st: The Suspicious Faith Healer and the Black Kirara
programmes.d: Tesso, a mouse demon who is afraid of cats, transforms into a faith healer, and chases out Kuroro, a Nekomata who is bothering him.
Kikyo was brought back to life by one of Urasue's secret techniques. She meets Monju, who is in the same situation.
In a certain village, Inuyasha and the gang are surrounded by villagers who dislike Miroku.
Inuyasha and the gang meet Izumo, who is investigating the secret of the creation of the Sacred Jewel.
Kagome and the others are kidnapped by demons who are using fake Sacred Jewels. Inuyasha and the rest go to save them, but Gyuoh stands in their way.
Naraku's poisonous bugs appear. Sesshomaru goes after them. Meanwhile, Jaken is stung by a poisonous bug and is dying. Rin is left with him.
Kirara disappears. Sango is worried. Shippo deduces Kirara's reasons for disappearing.

programmes.st: Kikyo and Kagome: Alone in the Cave
programmes.d: Kagome is lured to a cave by a voice calling for help. Kagome enters the cave and meets Kikyo.

programmes.st: Koga and Sesshomaru: A Dangerous Encounter
programmes.d: Ginta and Hakkaku fight with Koga over something small, and end up working separately from him. As they do, they meet Sesshomaru's group.

programmes.st: The Truth Behind the Nightmare: Battle in the Forest of Sorrow
programmes.d: Garamaru, a poisonous moth demon, has trapped Kagome and the others in a cocoon. Kagome and the others are each suffering within their nightmares.

programmes.st: The Snow from Seven Years Past
programmes.d: Snow is falling out of season. Miroku is abducted by Koyuki, a mysterious woman.
A giant ogre appears in the mountains to the north. His name is Kyokotsu. Kyokotsu eats demons when he can. He attacks the demon wolf tribe.
The Band of Seven, a group of ghosts, have been brought back to life.
The match between Jakotsu and Inuyasha is stopped when Mukotsu interferes. Mukotsu kidnaps Kagome to make her his bride.
Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have been weakened by Mukotsu's poison.

programmes.st: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango: Desperate Situation!
programmes.d: At the temple, Inuyasha checks to see of Kagome and the others are safe. He ends up trusting Renkotsu. Ginkotsu bombards him.

programmes.st: Inuyasha Shows His Tears For The First Time
programmes.d: Kagome, Miroku, and Sango have stopped breathing. Inuyasha searches for the Band of Seven to avenge them.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Pure Light
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang approach the light of a Sacred Jewel which appears to belong to the Band of Seven, but the light is not corrupt.
Jane and Adam's relationship seems to be moving at hyper-speed, and Jane thinks that it might be time for him to meet Mateo, but Rafael is not happy with this idea.
When Jane learns that Rafael introduced Mateo to his new girlfriend, Katherine, without her consent, she gets angry since she thinks Katherine has a negative influence on Rafael and Mateo.
When Adam reveals his dating past to Jane, the information puts a strain on their relationship.  Lina  seeks Jane's advice about whether she should get married.
Jane's book is finally being released but her plans to have a party at the local bookshop where she was inspired to be a writer hit a snag.
Jane is excited for her first book tour and brings Xo along for fun, but Alba decides last minute that she is going as well.
After Jane and Rafael decide to send Mateo to a new school, they become guilt-ridden when they are forced to lie to get him in.
Jane and Rafael realize that the uncertain state of their relationship is stressing out Mateo and they decide they need to make a decision.
Jane and Rafael try to be friends which works great until Jane goes on a date.  Petra and Jane's new partnership is off to a rocky start, but they know they have to find a way through it.
Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Joann says she hired the defendant as a handyman, and he did half the work then disappeared.
Jada is suing her mother for $4,000 in unreturned property after kicking her out of the house.
Jill is suing Laura after failing to repay a loan, but Laura says it was a gift.
Tyrone claims his ex wife Tania got him falsely arrested 3 times so he's here to sue her for $3,000.
Joan is taking Sena to court after she gave away 5 cats she asked Sena to care for after Hurricane Sandy.
Jennifer is accusing Michelle of causing the car crash and is suing her for the damages to her car.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.
Forrest hired the defendant to make a music video but claims he took too much creative liberty and wouldn't listen.
Nicole is suing the man she rented a room from after making her uncomfortable and changing the locks after a fight.
Amanda is suing her nail tech Jonyell after paying for her to take a nail class but she breached their contract.

Andrew is suing Rachel after buying a lemon car due to her distracting him by dressing provocatively.

A team of six clever kids enacts a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

Quincy is a thirty-something baggage handler by day and online video game master by night. Perfectly happy to live in his parents' home, Quincy has dedicated his life to being the best cyber athlete online, until his parents decide to move.

Dive into adventure with Sammy the sea turtle as he swims the ocean searching for the love of his life, Shelly. Based on the course of a sea turtle's life, this story of Sammy's breathtaking journey is a thrilling voyage the whole family will love!

programmes.t: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
programmes.d: When Sammy and Ray find themselves trapped in The Tank, an underwater aquarium, they must hatch a plan to escape and reunite with their grandkids, Ricky and Ella, and protect them from the dangers of the ocean.
A young girl and her coach overcome adversity to make their way into the National Australian Gymnastics Squad.
The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.
Three adventurous houseflies stow away on the Apollo 11 moon flight and are secret contributors to the mission's success. Animated fun voiced by Christopher Lloyd, Kelly Ripa, and more.
In futuristic Metro City, scientist Tenma (voiced by Nicolas Cage) creates an amazing robot boy with hidden talents unlike anything you've ever seen.
When a take-charge alpha wolf and a laidback omega wolf get relocated halfway across the country, the two must set off on an incredible journey home in this CGI-animated adventure.
Kai confronts his dad for aiding the Hands of Time, only to discover that his parents are actually Acronix and Krux's captives.

programmes.st: Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea
programmes.d: The Hands of Time blackmail Kai and Nya into using their combined Elemental powers to retrieve the fourth and final Time Blade from the Boiling Sea with the promise that the siblings can use its reversal power to save the quickly-fading Master Wu.

Kai and Nya stow away aboard Krux and Acronix’s time-traveling snake mech in a desperate attempt to save Master Wu. But when they arrive in the past, they must help the Elemental Masters prevent the Hands of Time from re-writing Ninjago history.
When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers.
In the wake of a vicious attack upon the palace, the Sons of Garmadon steal the second Oni Mask, and the ninja invite the royal princess, Harumi, into their makeshift family.
While Princess Harumi adjusts to life with the ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon.
In order to join the Sons of Garmadon, Zane (aka Snake Jaguar) participates in a deadly motorcycle initiation race.
Zane’s near demise at the hands of Mr. E forces the ninja to flee aboard the Bounty, where they discover that a transmission Zane intercepted may reveal the hidden location of the Quiet One.
As Lloyd and Harumi venture deep into Primeval’s Eye in search of the third Oni Mask, the ninja attempt to fix the Bounty and make a startling discovery.
As Lloyd and Harumi search the Oni Temple for the last mask, the ninja are taken hostage and discover Princess Harumi’s true intentions.
The ninja appeal to the police commissioner of Ninjago in an effort to help save Lloyd and thwart Harumi’s efforts to resurrect the evil Lord Garmadon.

Just when the Ninja think they have saved the day, Lord Garmadon returns to NINJAGO, and frees Harumi, who encourages him to “achieve his true potential” by conquering the one thing that has always stood in his way… his son, Lloyd.
The ninja race to save Lloyd, as a more powerful-than-ever Lord Garmadon creates an enormous Colossi to help him rule NINJAGO and defeat the ninja.
Ninjago has become a bleak, enemy-occupied city ruled by Emperor Garmadon and his Sons of Garmadon biker gang.
Jay, Kai and Zane are interrogated by Iron Baron, the ruthless warlord to the Dragon Hunters. Feeling threatened, the Ninja choose to keep their identities secret.

As the Ninja are put into a cage aboard a hunting party, they learn that their elemental powers will be used to help lure a dragon. Undercover, Cole learns Iron Baron is in search for Firstbourne’s nest – the Mother of All Dragons.

After a flashback of when Jay first meets Master Wu, Jay awakens to find he’s still with his caged friends returning from their hunting party. Forced into slave labor, Jay’s inspired by his dream of his master when Wu told him to ‘build the impossible’.

Dareth warns his friends just as the Sons of Garmadon ambush their secret headquarters. The Elemental Masters are each captured, except for Lloyd, Nya, Dareth and Skylor, who escape within Nya’s escape vehicle.
As Lloyd and his friends lick their wounds, Mystake shares how she managed to escape the Sons of Garmadon earlier -- she’s a shape-shifting Oni.
In the wastelands, Faith teaches the Ninja how to master their chain rifles and they hunt a dragon. As teen Wu struggles, Kai encourages him to not give up in a lesson of confidence.

Harumi has outed Mystake as the ‘Fake Harumi’. Mystake reveals her true Oni form and battles Garmadon, allowing Skylor to absorb some of his power and escape. In the Realm of Oni and Dragon, the Ninja return to rescue Faith, only to discover it’s a trap.
Garmadon is enraged by the loss of Harumi and releases his wrath by ordering the Oni Titan to turn Ninjago City to ash. Lloyd fears they won’t be able to endure much longer – where are his friends?
Atop their dragons, the Ninja return to Ninjago City amidst Garmadon’s vicious attack. Master Wu and the Ninja join up with Lloyd, Nya, and Dareth and they celebrate their reunion.
Nya helps Zane backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code.
Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane’s mind.  Jay reviews memories of the Ninja’s various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.
Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle by revisiting some of Ninjago’s distinctive destinations.
Kai enters Zane’s mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.
The team tackles a puzzle about technology in Ninjago while the threat to Zane grows graver by the minute.
A riddle requires the Ninja to consider the powers and history of the Elemental Masters.  Meanwhile, Nya struggles to keep the power on in the Samurai X Cave.
Jay, Kai and Zane remember some of Ninjago’s most fearsome creatures in order to help Cole defend the cave from an unidentified monster.
The Ninja confront memories of their greatest villain and ally, Garmadon, before the threat to Zane controls him completely.

programmes.st: Part 9: Prophecy of the Green Ninja
programmes.d: The final puzzle forces each ninja to question the true meaning of the Green Ninja Prophecy, but success is not what it seems.
Solving the puzzles releases a new peril for the Ninja to face.  Will memories of their greatest victories be enough to defeat it?
In the wake of their previous victory, the ninja go soft and Master Wu must remind them of who they truly are.
Realizing they have gone soft, the ninjas search for a quest to reignite their Spinjitzu training; unfortunately, Ninjago City is enjoying a period of rare tranquility.
The ninjas have found their quest. Now they just have to get there, which involves a road trip through the Desert of Doom, a region supposedly inhabited by a giant scarab beetle.
To repair the Land-Bounty, the ninjas must retrieve a critical engine component that has been swallowed by a giant scarab beetle.

programmes.st: Boobytraps and How to Survive Them
programmes.d: The ninjas team up with a reluctant Clutch Powers to enter a mysterious pyramid where they inadvertently unleash an ancient evil.
Lil' Nelson takes a job as a paperboy, which is more difficult than it sounds in a city overrun by scorching Pyro Vipers and an evil Serpentine sorceress.
The ninjas find themselves trapped in a pyramid and must escape encroaching lava to warn Ninjago City of a new Serpentine invasion.
The Serpentine attack on Ninjago City is seen from an unexpected perspective - entirely in the style of a live newscast delivered by Gayle Gossip and her cameraman.
The ninjas rush to the Ninjago Museum of History to recover a dangerous scroll before it falls into the hands of the Serpentine Sorceress, Aspheera.
While Aspheera pursues revenge on the "Treacherous Deceiver" who betrayed her, the ninja make a startling discovery.
A flashback episode tells the story of Young Wu and Young Garmadon meeting Aspheera and teaching her the secrets of Spinjitzu.
Having learned Master Wu is the "Treacherous One," the ninjas find themselves under siege at the Monastery, trying to protect Wu from the wrath of Aspheera.
The ninjas must break into the Explorer's Club to obtain the Second Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, running afoul of the club's manager and irate club-members.
Aspheera arrives at the Monastery of Spinjitzu and confronts Wu, forcing one of the ninjas to make a heroic sacrifice.
Having learned Zane is not dead, Master Wu prepares to go after him, but Lloyd and the other ninjas take matters into their own hands and defy their Master.

The ninjas arrive in the Never-Realm, where they quickly find themselves overwhelmed; luckily, they are taken in by a tribe of Ice Fishers who tell them Zane has been imprisoned by the evil Ice Emperor.
The Ice Emperor learns of the ninjas' arrival and sends his Blizzard Samurai warriors to destroy them and the villagers who sheltered them.
Lloyd runs afoul of the Ice Emperor's Blizzard Samurai but is rescued by a strange wolf, with whom an unlikely friendship develops.

A disappearing diary, a missing mistress and a preposterous police report pose problems for Matlock when he agrees to defend a psychiatrist, Lucas Forbes.

A woman arrives home to find her house on fire and her husband dead. The police believe she did it to kill her husband who supposedly was planning on leaving her. A newspaper reporter helps Ben and discovers the husband had a secret past.

Amidst the backdrop of Cliff's triathlon, four bank robbers try to recover their stolen loot. Matlock's old friend and ex-FBI agent, Ed Windgate, accidentally gets tied to the murder of a young investigator hired to track him.

Amidst the backdrop of Cliff's triathlon, four bank robbers try to recover their stolen loot. Matlock's old friend and ex-FBI agent, Ed Windgate, accidentally gets tied to the murder of a young investigator hired to track him.
A crooked photographer is murdered.
When a successful country music star is murdered, the promoter she fired – Steve Fisher – becomes the logical suspect.

Disagreeable London-based American businessman Albert Gordon is shot dead. His son Eric is the prime suspect. Believing Eric's innocent, sister Laura plans a mock trial hoping to uncover new evidence. Ben travels to London to defend Eric.
Matlock discovers he has more than enough suspects to go around for a murder which has the wrong man in jail.

Matlock’s daughter’s surprise visit home is interrupted when a judge, on a Blue Ribbon panel investigating the assassination of the town Mayor, is accused of sexual assault and seeks Matlock’s counsel.

When his daughter is jailed for contempt Matlock takes over her case. Now it is up to him to uncover the truth behind a sinister cover-up that involves high government officials, including the Chief of Police, in a child pornography ring and a murder.

Matlock upjocks the secret of a young piano student’s supposed suicide and discovers the keys to her death are jealousy, adultery, and blind ambition when a piano competition becomes more than just a musical affair.
Doctors find themselves accused of murder.
When Matlock returns to his hometown, he ends up defending an accused murderer and becoming the town’s worst enemy.
After the death of the second of three boys who witnessed a murder 15 years ago, the trial of Ben's client requires the exposure of the secrets of some of his hometown's most prominent residents.
Ben Matlock becomes involved in a mob blackmail scheme when he defends a famous criminal lawyer, David O’Malley, accused of murdering an underworld kingpin.

Matlock must pull out all the stops to keep his client, David O’Malley, a famed criminal lawyer in his own right, in line, and the jury on his side. Meanwhile, Conrad races against time to track down an informer that will crack the case.
A law school class reunion proves deadly for one of Matlock’s former classmates, and Ben takes on the defense of another old friend, George Dutton, the partner of the victim.

To help the IMF team break up a crime syndicate that specializes in brainwashing ex-convicts into committing political assassinations, Barney substitutes for a former prisoner looking for an operation to give himself a new appearance.

Robert Conrad guest stars as a professional assassin whom the Impossible Missions Force must prevent from Carrying out his assignment without knowing the identity of his target in "The Killer" segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Imry Rogosh is a mass murderer who kills to foment political upheaval. He is targeting Los Angeles, so the IMF knocks him out in a car accident.
An electronically guarded prison confronts the Impossible Missions Force when it tries to free a political prisoner (Richard Garland) from an escape-proof glass cell.

Henrik Durvard has taken over the country of Lombuanada by a military coup, and holds the natives in terror. He has obtained a diamond from the native miners, and the IMF is assigned to take it away from him.

Guest star Steve Forrest plays the role of a millionaire publisher and communications tycoon who has sold fifty-one percent of his empire to an underworld crime syndicate which gives them a powerful influence over state politics.

Before the IMF can get the prototype of an Iron Curtain country's secret weapon to the United States, part of the weapon falls into the hands of an unscrupulous, greedy nightclub owner, in "The Amateur"
The former dictator of a Caribbean island is made to have hallucinatory visions in which he sees his ominous destiny as part of an ingenious plot designed by the Impossible Missions Force.
George Maharis guest stars as John Bachman, an underworld figure with access to the syndicate's top secret computerized records who is convinced by the IMF that he has found the fountain of youth.

The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"
The IMF foils the attempts of a once-powerful communist to regain power.

The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.
Not knowing when, where, or how a dangerous adversary will strike, Jim Phelps and Cinnamon use themselves as human quarries.
To locate a hoard of stolen money, the IMF takes the one man who knows its hiding place (guest star Stephen McNally) on a bizarre submarine voyage on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Carl Betz, Barbara Anderson, and Robert Conrad guest star alongside Jim Phelps who, with the aid of Barney's electronic wizardry, takes on the guise of a hot-shot pool hustler to break up an illegal gambling operation.

John Colicos guest stars as a rebellious Caribbean government official, who plans to take over his country by having his president assassinated while in the United States to speak before a joint session of Congress
The team must trick a crooked investment promoter into endorsing $80 million in stolen stocks and then getting them back from him.
Mister Rogers helps out at Negri's Nusic Shop when Helena leaves to care for her sick son. Queen Sara learns that an employee of "Food for the World" is sick and her help is needed.
Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely show how they make an apple-peanut butter treat and remind children how much they learn from people other than their parents.
Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make peanut butter. Lady Aberlin agrees to take care of Daphne. Henrietta Pussycat suggests making a daycare center at the factory, and Corney agrees.

Mister Rogers meets Natasha, a famous oboeist. She shows pictures of her children and says she expresses her feelings for them through her music. Prince Tuesday is considering getting sick so that his parents will stay home from work.

Marilyn Barnett invites Mister Rogers outside for some exercises.  Bruce Franco carries a collection of balloon scuptures he has made for the party. He gives Mister Rogers a balloon sculpture that looks like the Neighborhood Trolley.

Mister Rogers introduces a week of programs about the environment. He shows how things can be reused. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, there's a real-life problem -- too much garbage -- and the neighbors are trying to find a solution.

Mister Rogers arrives with a bandage on his left hand. He pulls back the bandage to show that his hand is still there. Ana scraped her paw but does not want a bandage. Lady Aberlin is able to convince her otherwise.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make adhesive bandages. Prince Tuesday is looking for someone to play with but all of his friends are busy. At the suggestion of King Friday, he pretends that his rag doll has come to life.

Mister Rogers shows a video of wolves "singing," and wolf expert Kent Weber stops by with two wolves and explains that wolves are shy, not big and bad like in the fairy tales, and how they live together in families.
Folksinger Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers with her ukulele and shares songs her father enjoyed.
Yo-Yo Ma describes how he misses his family when he is gone and plays Bach's Sarabande on his cello. Sitting at the piano, Yo-Yo's son Nicholas plays the Skater's Waltz as a duet with his father.

Mister Rogers goes to Brockett's Bakery to decorate gingerbread men. After hearing the sound effect from the laughing box, Lady Aberlin sees how long neighbors take to laugh. Eric Kloss makes different sounds using a wind synthesizer.
Mister Rogers plays with different-sized cardboard tubes. Lady Aberlin is observing how neighbors react to the laughter box. Dr. Maggie Kimmel tells the story of “Button Broth.”

Mister Rogers shows a video of how people make toothbrushes. Lady Aberlin observes the neighbors' reactions after she can turn herself into a tiger. Princess Zelda arrives in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Learning to Take Care of Yourself
programmes.d: Mister Rogers brushes his teeth in his bathroom talks about how important it is to take care of our teeth, and even visits a dentist's office!

Mister Rogers shows a film of an earthmover digging a hole. Mr. McFeely shows a toothpaste video. Lady Aberlin wears a tiger suit, so she can be related to Daniel. Daniel declares that they are related by their hearts.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Has a Model Car
programmes.d: At the request of a television neighbor, Mister Rogers arrives with a model car and uses wooden blocks to build a roadway for it to travel. Prince Tuesday does not understand why he is not big like Neighbor Aber and King Friday.

programmes.st: Visit to a Conservatory for Plants
programmes.d: Mister Rogers plants a seed and visits a conservatory. King Friday orders Handyman Negri to sing a song about not being afraid. This makes the neighbors even more anxious about the “big thing” that is to arrive in the neighborhood.

Mister Rogers brings in a cat named Jimmy and remembers him as a kitten. He shows pictures of babies that have grown into adults. Everyone gathers at the castle just as the big thing rolls into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

programmes.st: Growing a Plant from a Seed
programmes.d: Mister Rogers says that the bean plant he planted a few days ago has grown. Robert Troll is the only one who can communicate with the “big thing.” He learns that it wants a blanket; the blanket causes it to sprout a stem and leaves.

Mister Rogers plays games that require patience.  Purple Panda experiments with a powder that causes flowers to grow. Prince Tuesday wishes the powder to make him grow. Mister Rogers goes to see the Harlem Spiritual Ensemble practice.
Harriett Cow shares the plans for a play. Lady Aberlin is greeted by a ballet dancer who dances her around the Neighborhood. The dancer inspires Ana Platypus to be a ballerina in the school play.

programmes.st: How Sweaters and Sneakers Are Made
programmes.d: Mister Rogers explains why he changes into a sweater and sneakers, and shows how people make sweaters and sneakers. Miss Paulificate brings Prince Tuesday's ragdoll to life by dancing with him. The neighbors decide their roles in a play.
Mister Rogers plays dress-up with wigs and glasses, and says: “You can get dressed up in the fanciest of things, but the best style comes from inside, and it often spreads on your face with a smile.”

King Friday suggests that the Neighborhood of Make-Believe be turned upside down to see if the missing crown might fall out. Trolley finds the spare crown! Mister Rogers visits the Boys Choir of Harlem.

Maggie Stewart is dressed as Mr. McFeely and delivers a film about how people make sweaters. The children put on a play about a princess, a raccoon and a giant king. Prince Tuesday admits he had something to do with the missing crown.

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow paint a portrait of Mr. McFeely. Robert Troll paints a portrait of King Friday who asks Lady Aberlin to have everyone copy it for themselves. Lady Aberlin explains that art comes from within each person.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers has a toy airplane
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a wooden toy airplane. Handyman Negri is working on a musical portrait of King Friday. Neighbor Aber provides his own tribute to King Friday as he mans his plane and draws a sky-written portrait of the King.

programmes.st: We all have art inside of us
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a picture of a blue tree. In art, you can make things any way you want. He also talks about visiting art museums.

As the war between bikes and cars escalates in the streets of L.A., Acting Assistant Chief Fritz Howard deploys Major Crimes to solve a tragic hit-and-run.
A murder investigation turns explosive while Captain Sharon Raydor duels with Chief Winnie Davis for control of her case. Meanwhile, Rusty gets some alarming news from Gus.

Commander Sharon Raydor continues to investigate the disappearance of the St. Joseph's Three and the possibility that two of the fifteen-year-old boys could be killers.

Gibbs' worst fears are confirmed when he learns that his nemesis, Arab/Israeli double agent Ari (Rudolf Martin), is back in Washington D.C. on assignment to kill him. (TV-PG)
While the NCIS team deals with Kate's death, Gibbs' determination to finally put an end to Ari's (guest star Rudolf Martin) reign of terror mounts.
Ari (guest start Rudolf Martin) continues to wreak havoc on the NCIS team as he uses its members as pawns in the game he is playing with Gibbs.

Under order from the Governor of Virginia, a skeptical Gibbs is forced to meet with a serial killer he helped to convict a decade before under the pretense that the killer will tell Gibbs where he hid missing bodies.

As Arthur prepares to undergo heart surgery, Carrie discovers something that he did years ago that drastically affected her life.
Carrie's boss, Pruzan, has his first big case as partner, and Carrie is overwhelmed with work.
Now that Arthur is back from the hospital, Carrie thinks that it is a good idea that she and Doug get life insurance.

Marcy freaks out when she begins having erotic dreams about Al after a heated argument about men vs women, and wonders whether she is actually sexually attracted to Al. Haunted by her dreams, Marcy ultimately comes to a conclusion and confronts Al.

Al and Peggy delay going to a closing of their favorite hamburger joint, Johnny Be Good's, when Bud and Kelly need them to solve their own problems. Meanwhile, Steve and Marcy prepare a party for their bosses at home.
Al is reluctant to have Buck neutered despite being threatened with lawsuits from numerous neighbors regarding Buck's "nocturnal carnal activities.”
The Bundys take a vacation to near-beautiful Dumpwater, Florida and stay in a cut-rate motel where an ax murderer that hates tourists shows up every five years since 1967.
Reggie makes John a test subject in her psychology experiment and Jake gets his driver's license renewed. (TV-PG)

Helen and Joe baby-sit their friend's little girl and dump their childhood neuroses on her.
Joe and Brian are reunited with their grandfather, Jack Hackett, who Helen and Casey discover is an imposter.

After announcing they've broken up, Lisa decides she'll only communicate with Dave in writing.

Andi hires a pretty, young babysitter, Sophia (Victoria Justice), to watch the kids, and gets jealous when her daughter, Kate, goes to her instead for advice.
Carrie and a guy (Curt) from her office get along well and when Doug finds out people at Carrie's office call Curt Carrie's 'work husband' he feels threatened. Even though he knows Curt is gay.
At a wedding, Doug takes a naughty picture with a disposable camera supplied by the bride and groom.
Doug and Carrie run into an ex-girlfriend of Doug from high school. She still has contact with Doug's mom, who's coming to town.
Carrie and Doug have four tickets for a month to the Knicks games and try to find the perfect couple to join them.

Becker throws his back out at home while trying to close a stuck window.
Two men on trial for killing an elderly man claim the old man got what he deserved. They tell the court that he had abused his family for decades.
A probe into how the justice system uses psychics to solve tough cases. Looks at how widespread the practice is, and whether or not psychic evidence holds up in court.

The shocking story of a Texan, reported to be worth $500-million, who murdered two people and hired a hitman to kill the judge in his divorce case, but used his wealth to win acquittals in both cases.
Police search through thousands of hours of CCTV to try to identify a sexual offender.
A care worker is accused of stealing a golden bracelet from the elderly woman she is caring for.
A murder is recorded on camera, and a woman is found stabbed multiple times.
A whirlwind romance ends with a woman dead under a blanket. In the UK, a man with stab wounds is discovered.
When three visitors to Signal Mountain are murdered in the woods, suspicion falls on Frank Casteel, who liked to threaten trespassers with his shotgun.

Life in the town of Duchesne, about 100 miles from Salt Lake City, is as hard as sun-baked rock and weather-beaten leather. Everyone must struggle to survive, except John Pinder, the ne'er-do-well son of a millionaire.

Somerset, Kentucky may be suburban on the surface, but when a modern-day bootlegger turns a political shindig into a shooting gallery, there's no doubt that this Kentucky town is still hillbilly at heart.

The folks of Lexington, Kentucky love two things: horses and University of Kentucky sports. But in 1994, it wasn't March Madness or the Triple Crown that had this college town on the edge of its seat.
The millionaire residents of a super-wealthy Florida town are stunned when one of the hired help--an exterminator--is accused of murdering a well-known 71-year-old female.
The hunt for copycat killers Sebastian Burns and Atif Rafay, whose technique was inspired by 1924 murderers Leopold and Loeb.
Wrongly convicted, David Milgaard spends 20 years in prison before DNA evidence proves his innocence and reveals the real killer.
When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors.  On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.
In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men.  He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg.  And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.
When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry.  But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programmes.st: To the Reverie! The Straw Hats' Sworn Allies Come Together!
programmes.d: As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don't fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy's exploits and remembers their shared past.

programmes.st: Sabo Goes into Action! All the Captains of the Revolutionary Army Appear!
programmes.d: A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard's affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help.

programmes.st: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
programmes.d: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

programmes.st: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
programmes.d: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague.

programmes.st: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
programmes.d: Stelly, Sabo's adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve.

programmes.st: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!
programmes.d: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

programmes.st: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
programmes.d: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

programmes.st: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
programmes.d: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon.

programmes.st: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
programmes.d: The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!

programmes.st: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
programmes.d: After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!

programmes.st: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
programmes.d: The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown!

programmes.st: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard's Last Memento!
programmes.d: In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard's homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

programmes.st: Climbing Up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!
programmes.d: Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!

programmes.st: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
programmes.d: A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano.

programmes.st: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido's Army!
programmes.d: Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!

programmes.st: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
programmes.d: Otama's gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!

programmes.st: Side Story! The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
programmes.d: Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre's group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny's Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution.

programmes.st: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
programmes.d: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

programmes.st: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding through the Wasteland!
programmes.d: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido's underlings show up too!

programmes.st: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
programmes.d: Otama's temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido's Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.

programmes.st: Defeat is Inevitable! The Strawman's Fierce Attack!
programmes.d: Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison.

programmes.st: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
programmes.d: Otama's life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun's men!

programmes.st: Charging into the Enemy's Territory! Bakura Town - Where Officials Thrive!
programmes.d: Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!

programmes.st: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!
programmes.d: As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo's back, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there.

programmes.st: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
programmes.d: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.

programmes.st: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
programmes.d: After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town's boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates' Headliners.

programmes.st: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
programmes.d: Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins is confronted by a mysterious figure.

programmes.st: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
programmes.d: Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town!

This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.

programmes.st: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! LuffytaroReturns the Favor!
programmes.d: Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.

programmes.st: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
programmes.d: Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin'emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin'emon's ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!

programmes.st: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
programmes.d: Kin'emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed.

programmes.st: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
programmes.d: Kin'emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke's mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes.

In 1981, a mother vanishes from the Hernando woods and the case goes cold and 33 years later, local detectives take the baton from Kelly and the Cold Justice team only to discover that getting a confession may be the only way to solve the case.

Crystal Rogers, mother of five, vanishes, leaving her car abandoned in Bardstown, Ky.; a year later her father is shot dead while searching for her; there are multiple cases in a small town shrouded in secrets, and haunted by unsolved killings.
Stephanie and Dwayne look through Tommy Ballard's box of papers and evidence in Crystal's case.

The FBI grills the brother of Crystal's boyfriend, Nick Houck, a Bardstown police officer; Stephanie and Dwayne follow a search of a lake where cadaver dogs pick up a scent; exploring the scene of a deadly ambush on the Bluegrass Parkway.
An FBI profiler offers chilling insights on a potential killer; family members of Bardstown's other victims speak; a mysterious white car is possibly linked to Crystal's disappearance.

With the first anniversary of Tommy Ballard's killing approaching, Stephanie and Dwayne dive deeper into the unsolved cases after a new witness steps forward; an unexpected new lead takes them in an unforeseen -- and intriguing -- direction.

Stephanie and Dwayne speak with an informant who shares new information about the crimes in Bardstown; they follow up on the informant's claims and discover potential new details unknown to investigators.
Journalist Maggie Freleng searches for answers in the 2004 disappearance of a nursing student following a car crash in New Hampshire.
Maggie investigates reasons why Maura Murray secretly drove to New Hampshire and never came home, including a possible pregnancy or an emotional phone call with her sister.

There are questions about happened to Maura after she crashed on a rural road in New Hampshire: did she run into the woods, hop into a car with someone she knew and escape to a new life in Canada, or worse, hitch a ride with a dangerous stranger.

New Hampshire's law enforcement community keeps their findings of Maura's case close to the chest; Maggie explores the theories related to a police conspiracy, hoping to break down a decade-long code of silence.
Killers and kidnappers are Maggie's focus as she works to find out if Maura Murray was the victim of foul play.

The DNA results are revealed; Maggie seeks the advice of a psychic; a wild lead is pursued at the top of a mountain; Maggie sits down with Maura's family and reveals evidence released by law enforcement for the first time in 13 years.

programmes.d: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division.

programmes.st: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich
programmes.d: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928 and 1943.
On September 1, 1939, Germany invaded Poland in a blitzkrieg fueled not only by tactics and technology, but also by Pervitin, a crystal meth.
Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war.
The Second World War was the closest the world has come to a complete total war.
Total War demands resources: economic, agricultural and industrial. It draws upon the labour and the morale of entire populations to meet its needs.
The Second World War shattered the boundaries between battlefield and home-front in much of the world.
In the Second World War civilians became defenders against and targets of aerial warfare on a scale never before seen.
Total War was not the cause of the Holocaust but it did provide a means for its execution. This episode will explore what role total war played in this genocide.
The end of the Second World War brought destruction and liberation, relief mixed with grief. Explore the aftermath of total war.
In Taiwan, an American family refuses to believe there are ghosts in their house until their daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest explains that their house was designed to empower the dead.
Shortly after Whitney's family moving into their first home, a restless spirit shatters the serenity of their suburban life.
When Clara and her family move into a small home in rural Hinsdale, New York, they realize that the peace of life in the country is merely an illusion‚ and the threat of death is very real.

Ed and Beth's ranch house seems like the perfect place to raise their toddler‚ until they discover that they are not alone and a dark heavy mist that hangs over the house‚ and grows larger, day-by-day

Tiffany McKinnon, her boyfriend and his 7-year-old daughter move into a 200-year-old farmhouse Franklin, VA. Tiffany discovers that the spirit of a freed slave is haunting the home and is determined to make peace with him.

Soon after moving in a large apartment in Hampton, Tennessee, Amelia's family can't shake the feeling that they are not alone. An evil entity lurks in their dream home and is targeting family members. They turn to paranormal investigators for help.
Mary Vogel has been a spiritual counselor for ten years, but a recent encounter with the demonic forces her to question everything she knows and trusts. Only an exorcism can save her soul.

A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. Paranormal experts investigate and uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

After Mike and his girlfriend Lisa move in their new house, Lisa's personality begins to change dramatically. A late night encounter with an invisible entity convinces Mike that their home is haunted.
When William falls ill, Amanda Morrison's family volunteer to clean his home. But after the family stumbles across satanic objects in the home, strange things start happening.

When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.
Jan's seven-year-old son Cody begins communicating with an imaginary friend who lives in a red box in a nearby cemetery. Feeling helpless and desperate to protect her son, Jan contacts a shaman.

After a major surgery forces Jacinda Rearick to recuperate at home, she discovers orbs in family photos. At first, Jacinda believes that they are her deceased parents watching over her. But something much more sinister is invading her home.

In Brookfield, CT, young David suffers from intense nightmares and is physically attacked by an invisible entity. Paranormal investigators make contact with a legion of demons inside the child's body.

Carl, Keith and Cynthia Johnson begin using a spirit board, to communicate with the spirit haunting their home. But when their sister, Cynthia, is attacked both boys realize they are in over their heads and reach out to a paranormal investigator for help.

Mark Corvo finds a ceremonial alter in his attic. He reaches out to the Ghosts of New England Research Society for professional help. They believe tenants dabbling in the dark arts opened a portal to the other side and drew spirits to the location.

Soon after moving into an older home in a quaint suburb of Cincinnati, OH, Taylor Jones catches her mother practicing black magic in her daughter Isabelle's bedroom. Her fears become reality when Taylor notices Isabelle playing with an invisible friend.
Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

Good girl Mary (Jena Malone) can't believe it when she gets pregnant by her newly-gay boyfriend. She also can't believe the actions of her popular, relentlessly devout best friend, Hilary Faye (Mandy Moore).
Brian risks everything to bring down Stockwell on the eve of the election.
The season four opener finds Brian in debt and Ted in rehab.
Brian launches his own ad agency; Ted struggles post-rehab.
Ted begins a new job; Brian warns Justin about his friends.
A social worker's visit to Michael and Ben's doesn't go well.
Ted accepts Brian's job offer; Justin visits a firing range.
Michael and Justin receive an offer from Hollywood.
Brian is diagnosed with cancer; Ted falls back into old habits.
Justin discovers the truth about Brian's phony trip to Ibiza.
Michael and Ben struggle to survive a Hollywood windfall.
Brian picks up a teenager, then rebuffs his attempts to see him again.
Michael remains closeted at work - and jealous over Brian and Justin.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.
Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

World War Z is the fast-paced, pulse-pounding epic of the potential last days of the human race. Former United Nations employee Gerry Lane (Brad Pitt) is called in to help stop the pandemic from spreading worldwide.

Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.
