Unknown to the residents of Raccoon City, a huge underground bioengineering facility has accidentally unleashed the deadly T-virus. Now a team of highly-trained super commandos must race to isolate the T-virus before it overwhelms humanity.

Harlan Kent, President and CEO of Yankee Candle, the leading designer, manufacturer, wholesaler and retailer of premium scented candles, goes undercover where his customer service skills leave several co-workers questioning his true identity.

Mark King, President and CEO of TaylorMade Golf Company, the largest manufacturer of golf equipment and apparel in the world, is forced to break cover when an employee grows suspicious of her new trainee.

Mark, always the prankster, finally gets a dose of his own medicine when he plays golf against Masters Champion and PGA bad boy Bubba Watson.  Meanwhile, Alma, Bob and Brandon visit the former hospital where Alma use to work as a nurse.

Dale Earnhardt Jr invites Mark out for a NASCAR race in New Hampshire. Mark  has Paul and Bob deliver Wahlburgers to top NASCAR drivers, Greg Biffle and Ricky Stenhouse Jr.  Meanwhile, Brandon flies out to Chicago to visit Donnie and get a singing lesson.

With the grand opening of the Fenway Wahlburgers location, new investor Bob challenges the local Boston rival "Tasty Burger" to a game of softball at Fenway Park.  All the Wahlberg brothers show up and do battle on the legendary diamond of the Boston Sox.

Donnie puts a ballot box in Wahlburgers so customers can vote on who they think Alma's favorite son. Alma tries to put a stop to it when Donnie and Bob's campaigning gets out of control. Pebble Beach, California, Mark and Watson team up to compete.

While Mark and Paul are in Orlando for the Grand Opening of the first Wahlburgers in Florida, they squeeze in a competitive game of minigolf with Paul's kids. Paul is forced to leave early, Mark finds a way to declare a winner before the day is done.
Donnie hosts a charity poker tournament for Mark's Youth Foundation and ups the ante when he gets Paul, Bob, and Jim to make a side bet on who will be the last Wahlberg remaining in the competition.

After scouting the new Wahlburgers Dorchester location, Paul, Bob and Alma visit the old house Alma and some of the kids moved into after her divorce from their dad. Meanwhile, Brandon is taken with creating a Wahlburgers calendar for Alma.
Jeff gets talked into buying a mangy stuffed polar bear that could prove difficult to sell.
Jeff learns a bitter lesson when an old friend steals a lucrative deal right out from under him. Meanwhile, much-loved employee Christine departs Direct Liquidation.
Jeff's makes a big promise and decides to host an auction to sell used karts when a local go-kart track goes out of business.
Jeff has one day to clear out a Chinese grocery store full of exotic and vile stock.

A shoplifter takes on a security guard in Oregon. A brawl breaks out in a parking lot in Illinois as thousands of concert goers try to leave at once. An emergency room doctor's horrific bedside manner is caught on camera in California.
A woman in Idaho tries to steal a chainsaw by stuffing it in her pants. Disgusted customers watch a woman eat directly from the serving ladle at restaurant buffet.
A customer fights a raging fire in a New Jersey superstore. A mother in Massachusetts calls 911 on her son's barber. Late-night brawlers in Maryland end up crashing through a store's window.
At a fast food restaurant in Florida, a customer acts out after claiming to witness uncleanly behavior from an employee. A jewelry shop owner in China wrestles with a robber wielding a large knife.
A man accused of cutting in line at an Arkansas drive-thru has to contend with an angry local. A brawl breaks out at a baseball game in Philadelphia when a sports fan is blocked from leaving his row.

An Ohio customer fights fast food employees, apparently over a customized drink. A Scottish man has trouble ordering at an Alabama drive-thru. At a New York diner, a server tells off a customer. Thieves try to rob a gun store in Tennessee.
Seven former bosses reflect on their memorable "busted" moments. The tables are turned when a former boss dons one last disguise.

Shane Evans, COO of Massage Heights, goes undercover to find the kinks in her company. One store's disregard for company policy rubs the Boss the wrong way. Can the boss of one of the largest massage chains in North America actually give a massage?

In the series first, a Native American Boss goes undercover. Bruce "Two Dogs" Bozsum, Chairman of Mohegan Sun Casino, goes all in while undercover inside his Indian gaming empire. Does the Boss have enough gas in the tank to work the valet line?

Ursula hopes her pet chinchilla will bring her luck at an auction in East Gwillimbury, but little Monty has ideas of his own. Rick and Cindy get into watersports, Paul and Bogart make a virtue of chastity, and Roy comes to work in his pajamas.

Tensions run high between Roy and Ursula at an auction in Thornhill. Roy brings his dog for support and Ursula does her best to ignore them. Paul and Bogart hope their life coach will give them a leg up, and Cindy can't hear a word anyone is saying.

Paul and Bogart swore never to bring Bogart's sisters to another auction, which is why Roy brings them to one in Cambridge. Rick and Cindy try getting lucky with some models, while Ursula hopes magician Zack Mirza can make money materialize.

programmes.st: Roy Dimbeck: The Roy Dimbeck Story
programmes.d: After months of waiting for Cindy to set a wedding date, Rick makes a bold move at an auction in Mississauga. Roy records his memoirs for bidding posterity. Ursula finds a new place to stash her booze, and Paul and Bogart get conched on the head.

Roy antagonizes the buyers at an auction in Don Mills with free psychological analysis. Ursula tries to rein in Paul's reckless bidding habits while Bogart's away making wedding plans. Rick preaches caution, but Cindy goes for the big score.

Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

Aspiring movie star and hustler Maxine Minx (Mia Goth) finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of 1980s Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.
A gunned down Navy SEAL Master Chief must guide a child to safety through a gauntlet of hostile Taliban insurgents and survive the brutal Afghanistan wilderness.

Marlowe, a gripping thriller set in 1939 LA. Hard-boiled private eye, Philip Marlowe, is hired to find the lover of a glamorous heiress. Unexpectedly, Marlowe finds himself embroiled in a deadly mystery that he's determined to either solve or die trying.

Broke and depressed, Ray (John Magaro) is mistaken for a dangerous hitman and given an envelope of cash. Along with his P.I. friend Skip (Steve Zahn), he must escape the actual hitman to make it out of LaRoy alive.
Ross launches the website Silk Road, an anonymous drug market, catching the focus of DEA agent Rick. As their private lives erode, they are trapped in a game of cat-and-mouse.

World leaders meet at the G7 but get lost in the woods whilst trying to compose a joint statement on an unspecified global crisis. Beset by thick fog and menaced by undead bog bodies and a giant brain, they navigate the tortured passions between them.

Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programmes.t: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programmes.d: A mother falls for a younger man while her daughter falls in love for the first time. Mother Nature messes with their fates.

A successful sports agent (Taraji P. Henson) mysteriously gains the ability to hear men's thoughts. With this newfound power, she looks to outsmart her colleagues but the lengths she goes to put her relationships to the test in this hilarious comedy!

Tripp, a 35 year-old who still lives with his parents.  And who can blame him. It’s free, he’s got a great room, and mom does the laundry.  Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.
Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.
Montana Moore is determined to get engaged before her sister’s wedding in just 30 days!

programmes.t: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programmes.d: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.
He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.
Driven by sensual photography, trance-like music, and droll humor, Jim Jarmusch’s ONLY LOVERS LEFT ALIVE is a meditation on art, science, and the mysteries of everlasting love.
Hearing that his village is being threatened by a warlord and his gang, Merlin travels home.
Arthur kills a unicorn, bringing a curse down upon all of Camelot.
When Gwen's father is imprisoned for treason and killed, Morgana decides she must take revenge.
How far is the Merlin prepared to go to protect his destiny and what will he have to sacrifice?
Merlin is convinced a slippery newcomer is up to something.
Merlin helps Arthur disguise his identity to enter a jousting tournament.
When Morgana's nightmares spill into waking hours, she becomes terrified that she has magic.
Gwen is mistaken for Morgana and kidnapped by the savage outlaw Hengist.
Uther is captivated by his latest guest, the beautiful Lady Catrina.
Newly crowned Queen Catrina settles in as Camelot's first lady.

When the King's madness and cruelty reaches a fevered pitch, Mary and Francis take action. Their choices could change the course of history, but an unforeseen terror brewing in the woods could cost them, and their friends, everything.

The new King and Queen of France, Francis and Mary are plummeted into chaos after the Black Plague ravages the land and creeps inside the castle, threatening lives and the stability of their new rule.
In the aftermath of the plague, a powerful lord discovers that Mary was responsible for the death of his son and demands vengeance, testing the loyalties of Mary, Francis and Catherine.
With France in a state of famine, as well as religious and political unrest, Mary looks for a way to feed the people, risking the wrath of a vengeful Lord Narcisse.
When a shepherd is attacked by shadowy riders in the night, Bash and Lord Condé investigate what may be the unrest of angry spirits or the beginnings of a religious war.
Tensions between Protestants and Catholics escalate when bloodshed at a Protestant service causes an already concerned Mary and Francis  to intervene on the eve of Greer's wedding.
Upon encountering a mob of angry peasants, Queens Mary and Catherine find themselves concealing their true identities after being forced to abandon their carriage and escape into the woods.
The team struggles to gas up in a dangerous oil refinery packed with zombies.
While Walter deals with some very upsetting news — he tells Olivia's niece, Ella (LILY PILBLAD), a fairy tale that includes musical performances by Olivia and Agent Broyles.
Peter teams up with a local law enforcement official on a serial murder investigation with ties to Newton. And someone from the "other side" pays a visit.
Walter and Olivia venture into the alternate world for the anticipated face-off with William Bell (special guest star LEONARD NIMOY) in the first of a two-part season finale.
The universes may never be the same on the Season 2 Finale!
In the Season Three premiere, a disoriented Olivia fights to find her way home, while Peter and Walter try to move on with their lives — unknowingly alongside the alternate Olivia.
Key information about the future is revealed when Walter and Nina meet at Massive Dynamic for the emotional reading of the last will and testament of William Bell.
Timing is critical as a series of anomalous events leads the Fringe Division to investigate deadly incidents with unimaginable coincidences.
The team comes to Addy's rescue after a 'family' of cannibals kidnaps her.
Citizen Z directs the team to a rumored helicopter parked atop a skyscraper where zombies roam freely.
A tornado forces the team to Warren's hometown. There, she searches for her long-lost husband.
The team fights for survival against a zombie-worshipping cult.

programmes.st: Do Shapeshifters Dream of Electric Sheep?
programmes.d: Newton is forced to call to action a sleeping shapeshifter. As Walter and the rest of the team move the investigation to Massive Dynamic, Olivia goes on high alert.
The alternate universe Fringe Division investigates a shocking breach of security when a twin frees his brother (guest stars SHAWN and AARON ASHMORE) from a quarantined Amber area.
The Fringe Division (over here) investigates a bizarre case when 15 people all suffer retrograde amnesia from listening to their shortwave radios on the same frequency.
When a serial kidnapper "over there" strikes again, the familiar case hits home for Colonel Broyles, who sends a determined Olivia to investigate the abductions.
Peter grapples with the aftermath of recent events as Olivia desperately searches for an ally. Meanwhile, the Team discovers a critical device that communicates between universes.
The most important planet in the solar system is our home, the Earth. It is the only planet we know that harbours life.
Space technologies are continuing to be refined and access to space is becoming cheaper.
The development of reliable, high-powered boosters has enabled researchers to send probes to distant planets.
Early in the life of the solar system Mars appears to have had Earth-like conditions.
This episode explores how we will deal with our changing water supply in the future.
You may not have a robot in your home now, but odds are you will within the next decade.
Robots are no longer science fiction, they are a fact of science and their creators are featured.
Nature is inspiring all sorts of futuristic designs.
As society advances new technologies are applied to what we learn and the ways we learn it.
The materials that go into our vehicles, homes, and appliances are undergoing a revolution.
Sound - you don’t think much about it, but futurists and entrepreneurs do.
High tech is revolutionizing the way kids learn AND the way teachers teach.

programmes.t: Voyage of the Continents: Central America
programmes.d: Central America takes us back to when the world was young. A fragile line of islands linking North and South America, the islands of the Caribbean are recent apparitions on earth and may not be here to stay.

programmes.t: Voyage of the Continents: South America
programmes.d: One glance at a map of South America says it all: Andes and Amazonian basin. Two huge geological characteristics that describe how the continent came into being. The Amazon was once under the sea.

programmes.t: Voyage of the Continents: Oceania: The Tectonic Ring of Fire
programmes.st: Oceania: The Tectonic Ring of Fire
programmes.d: Australia is now a solid and stable continent surrounded by more volatile neighbors. Pacific and Australian plates clash across the South Pacific causing intense geological and volcanic activity. Travel back in time through deserts, rock and fossils.

programmes.t: Voyage of the Continents: Asia: The Tectonics of Life and Death
programmes.st: Asia: The Tectonics of Life and Death
programmes.d: First Asia hurtled into Europe. Then, India crashed violently into the Asian continent. That shock gave birth to the highest mountain range in the world, the Himalayas. But it also released dangerous gases believed to have caused dinosaur extinction...
Building for God reached a high point in the Middle Ages with Notre Dame.
Temples, designed to honor the Gods, have been at the heart of cities since earliest times.
Without water, civilization is simply not possible; Romans took control of their water seriously.
As far back as the Bronze Age, humans were building ships capable of crossing oceans and trading.
Tornados are one of the most destructive forces of the planets with winds at 300 miles an hour. They can destroy buildings and hurl cars hundreds of feet through the air.

The Rockies. Magnificent and awe-inspiring mysterious, the Rockies are one of the longest mountain ranges in the world. Naked Science investigates the geological processes that build these massive mountains.

For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.
While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.
Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

The story of neo-cool Enid and Rebecca who, faced with graduation from high school take a hard look at the world they wryly observe. When Rebecca focuses her attention on mutual romantic fixation Josh, the girls friendship is forever changed.

Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.
Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.
A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.
Jimmy Rabbitte, an unemployed Dublin boy, decides to put together a soul band made up entirely of the Irish working class.
Violet dreams of becoming a popstar to escape her small-town life, entering a singing competition that will test her integrity, talent, and ambition.
A father and daughter form an unlikely songwriting duo in the summer before she leaves for college.
Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.
A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.
From the director of SUPERBAD comes a coming-of-age comedy of big dreams, hysterical consequences, and young love, set in a run-down amusement park.

Lily is reserved and awkward, while Jarrod is an introspective oddball who's blind to Lily's affection for him -- until a celebration mixed with a strange plan to exact revenge on Jarrod's high school foe brings the two misfits together.

From Academy Award winner Taika Waititi, this heartfelt comedy follows the adventure of a misfit kid (Julian Dennison) and his foster uncle (Sam Neill) who go on the run in the vast New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.
While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

On a prom night dare, a trio of high school friends chants an incantation, unleashing an evil spirit from the past with deadly consequences.
After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.
A sensual mystery thriller about strange happenings in a small North Carolina town. A college student stumbles across a bizarre mystery and wants to know more, perhaps too much more.

In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.
A Hollywood stunt performer (Ryan Gosling) who moonlights as a wheelman discovers that a contract has been put on him after a heist gone wrong.

As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair faces an even greater threat lurking beneath the surface.

Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.
When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.
Leonardo DiCaprio and Oscar-nominee Kate Winslet light up the screen as Jack and Rose, the young lovers who find one another on the maiden voyage of the "unsinkable" R.M.S. Titanic.

From three-time Oscar-winning director Steven Spielberg, Catch Me If You Can follows Frank W. Abagnale, Jr. as he successfully passes himself off as a pilot, a lawyer, and a doctor - all before his 21st birthday!

Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.
For more than a decade, a genius doctor with a homicidal hobby gets away with murder at hospitals across two continents.

After meeting up with college friends who are no longer into partying, Jeff and Audrey set out to prove that even with a baby on the way, they can still have fun. Meanwhile, Timmy attempts to find Russell's compassionate side.
When Audrey bonds with their unborn baby by reading her stories, a paranoid Jeff believes that she is trying to form an alliance against him. Meanwhile, Russell steals an article that Timmy wrote.

Jeff promises to take Audrey to an upmarket and very popular restaurant but forgets to book a table. Determined to dine there, he hatches a plan to get in by claiming that a last-minute reservation is needed for a celebrity.

Brenda enlists Jeff and Audrey's help when she does the catering for an event at Columbia University. While waitressing, Audrey tries to fit in with the guests, only to discover that they are more impressed with Jeff's bartending skills.

The couples attempt to enjoy recreational cooking classes together, but Jeff and Adam can't keep their competitive nature out of the kitchen.  Russell doesn't notice how disturbingly similar his new girlfriend is to Timmy.

When Jennifer learns that the guys have nothing planned for Adam's last weekend as a bachelor, she plans a party weekend.  Things don't go as planned, however, so Jeff, Russell, and Timmy must improvise.

When Becky helps Harris keep a secret from Darlene, it opens up a can of worms that causes a rift between the two sisters. Jackie supports Peter with his Nordic history project, and Dan reunites with an old friend.

While returning to the Enterprise aboard the shuttlecraft, Kirk, Spock, McCoy and a seriously ill Federation diplomat find themselves kidnapped by an energized cloud.
Tensions run high when the Enterprise transports ambassadors to the Babel conferences.

The Enterprise must deal with a creature from Kirk's past that feeds on human blood.

After returning to where they left the Enterprise and finding only the scattered remains of their ship, Trip and Reed struggle to survive and hope for rescue with only a few days worth of oxygen left inside Shuttlepod One.
Encountering a group of Vulcan pilgrims on a mission to explore their emotions, T'Pol is enticed to attempt some of their technique with a handsome and charming pilgrim, Tolaris.
Archer and his crew encounter a group of alien hunters upon a rogue planet that has broken out of its orbit.
The entire Enterprise crew is knocked unconscious by a plundering Ferengi crew through a Trojan horse gas canister, leaving the ship to be easily ransacked.
Exploring a crashed ship on a desolate planet, Trip finds the stranded crew still alive despite the seemingly insurmountable odds, but something about them isn't quite right.
Wrongfully imprisoned for ignorantly trespassing, Archer and Mayweather are taken prisoner by the Tandarans and find themselves in a Suliban internment camp.

From a visiting alien ship, a fibrous, web-like creature secures itself inside an Enterprise launch bay and ensnares several crewmen. Hoshi must work to learn the creature's bizarre language in order to save the trapped crewmen.
Archer must delay the crew's much-needed shore leave to transport a Vulcan Ambassador from her planet of Mazar to rendezvous with a Vulcan ship.
Archer and Trip aid a disabled vessel and, in gratitude for their assistance, the vessel's captain invites the two officers to dinner in his desert-landscape village on his nearby home planet.
Finally arriving at the paradise of planet Risa, the Enterprise crew is able to enjoy two days and nights of much needed shore leave.
The temporal cold war heats us as Captain Archer is taken to the 31st century by the Sulibans.

As Archer makes his way back from the 31st century to prevent the Sulibans destroying the Enterprise, his crew tries to fend off the violent machinations and interrogations of leader Silik and come up with their own plan to keep the ship safe.

T'Pol relates a tale of the Vulcans real First Contact when she claims that a relative of hers crash-landed in Carbon Creek, Pennsylvania in 1957, mingled with the townsfolk, and rescued workers in a mining accident.

When Enterprise is struck by a soon-to-detonate weapon and lodges in the ship's hull, Reed must deactivate it, but his subsequent injury and a group of encroaching Romulans bent on destruction force Archer think creatively to save the crew and ship.

To facilitate a lengthy list of necessary repairs, the crew visits an alien station with a super-computer that can fix anything.  But the automated station's demands for payment seem too good to be true...until Mayweather is discovered dead.
Archer spends a sleepless night tending to his quarantined beagle Porthos and figuring out how to apologize to the quirky, ritualistic Kreetassens he inadvertently offended on a recent visit.
Archer feels compelled to help a rustic alien colony that finds their rich resources constantly dwindling due to the Klingons' pillaging ways.
Ens. Wesley Crusher suffers from the pangs of first love when the Enterprise is tasked to transport a young woman, Salia, back to her home where she is to become the leader of her people.

Picard and the Enterprise respond to a distress call from its sister ship the USS Yamato. It has been facing a number of serious technical glitches and they lost 18 crew members when the containment field on a shuttle failed.

When the Enterprise is advised by a passing Klingon vessel that there is strange debris in orbit around a nearby planet, they investigate only to find a piece of a NASA spacecraft emblazoned with the US flag.
Deep in space, the Enterprise comes across a Federation shuttlecraft that is floating in space and without much power but which does exhibit the life signs of one human aboard.

Riker's delight at being offered command of the USS Aries turns to frustration when the man sent to prepare him for his mission is his estranged father; Worf's behavior leads Wesley to delve into Klingon tradition.
On arriving at a newly identified planetary group, the crew finds that the entire system is unstable.
Q tries to prove that Picard needs him as part of their crew by hurling the Enterprise 7,000 light-years away from where they encounter the Borg for the first time.
With Picard away for routine surgery, the Enterprise responds to an apparent distress call from a Pakled vessel.

programmes.st: Up the Long Ladder (aka "Send In the Clones")
programmes.d: When Starfleet receives an Earth-like distress signal from deep in space, the Enterprise is sent to investigate.

The Enterprise is transporting delegates to a diplomatic conference dealing with Federation membership. Counselor Troi is more than just a bit embarrassed when her mother Lwaxanna, as outrageous as ever, arrives on board the Enterprise.
The Enterprise is ordered to proceed to an emergency Rendez-Vous to collect a special envoy who is traveling from Starbase 153 to meet them.
The crew of the Enterprise participates in war games.

Riker returns from an away team mission wounded and infected with microbes from the planet below. He is soon in a coma in sick bay, the microbes having fused itself to his sciatic nerve and impeding his normal functions.

The new Starship Enterprise and its crew set out “to boldly go where no one has gone before." Their first mission is to explore the mystery surrounding the creation of the Farpoint station located on planet Deneb IV.
At the trial, "Q" continues to denounce humans, while Picard defends his race and convinces "Q" that the upcoming mission at Farpoint will be the perfect opportunity to prove his point.
The crew of the Enterprise is infected with a virus that causes them to behave as though they were intoxicated.
When the leader of an alien culture takes a romantic interest in Lt. Yar, he claims her for his own, to the dismay of his own wife, who, in turn, challenges Tasha in a fight to the death.
Janeway sends the ship's doctor on his first Away Mission: rescue the crew members who have vanished in the holodeck's version of Beowulf.
An encounter with a strange nebula leaves Chakotay brain-dead and the crew battling a powerful force that seems to be taking over their minds.
Voyager's half-human, half-Klingon Chief Engineer Torres is split into two beings by a scientist desperate to cure the plague that's destroying his people.
A painful chapter in Neelix's past is reopened when the man responsible for killing his family beams aboard Voyager.
Tuvok incurs the wrath of Maquis crewmembers when he's put in charge of a "boot camp" designed to bring them up to Starfleet standards.
The crew explores a remote planet inhabited by humans who were abducted by aliens in 1937
Chakotay faces an unlikely enemy: a Kazon boy who hopes to achieve warrior status by killing him.
The ship's holographic doctor experiences a world where illusion and reality collide.
The ship is surrounded by creatures whose presence accelerates Kes' reproductive process and threatens Voyager's key operating systems.
Ensign Harry Kim awakens on Earth, where he's shocked to learn there's no record of his assignment on Voyager.
A strange spatial distortion afflicts the ship and has the entire crew literally lost on their own ship.
Neelix and Paris must put aside their romantic rivalry over Kes after they crash-land on a toxic planet.
A mysterious force puts the crew in a delusional state that causes their most deeply buried thoughts and desires to surface.
Chakotay is stranded on a planet inhabited by natives with ties to his ancestors.
Kes makes contact with Ocampa spacefarers and the female Caretaker, who may have the power to send the crew home.
The theft of a transporter module by Kazon forces thrusts Chakotay into an explosive confrontation with his traitorous former lover Seska.
Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.

Investigating an abandoned space station, McKay mistakenly brings one of its scientists out of stasis. The scientist explains to the team that the base was the last effort by his people to avoid the repeated culling they've endured by the Wraith.

With the entire city ordered to take a personal day the team does their best to unwind and enjoy their leisure time. Without warning a mysterious explosion rips through the city killing and injuring unsuspecting citizens.

The team searches the ocean for a mobile geothermal drilling station the ancients left dormant. Cautiously exploring the station, Teyla thinks she senses the presence of a Wraith. Weir, believing it's pressure affecting Teyla, has the team press on.

After helping relocate the Taranans, the Atlantis team realizes they haven't heard from the village in a long period of time. It appears the Taranans have just abandoned their village until McKay detects life signs well beneath the surface.

The team is shocked when a satellite housing a stargate takes up orbit above Atlantis. When the stargate begins transmitting an energy beam, attacking the city, McKay takes a page from the Ancients and opts to sink Atlantis back into the ocean.

Destiny discovers the survivors of an interplanetary expedition who claim their civilization, Novus, was founded two thousand years earlier by Destiny’s crew. Suddenly, they are attacked by the Drones who have discovered a way to track Destiny.

Returning the settlers to their home planet Novus, the Destiny crew discover the planet has been abandoned and is on the verge of seismic destruction. While pouring through an underground archive, the crew learns of the true origins of Novus.

When Destiny’s attempt to recharge in a star is foiled by attacking drones, Eli suggests a risky plan to recharge in a super-hot blue giant…a star so hot it could destroy the ship…unless someone stays aboard and keeps the ship under manual control.

After a battle, Destiny’s only option for survival is a jump to the next galaxy. Crew members return to Earth to say what may be their final farewells before embarking on their journey. But a risky stop may put the entire plan in jeopardy.

Col. Jack O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) and his new SG recruits have become the targets of a secret hostile takeover. Now it's up to a wounded O'Neill and his neophyte troop to save the command center from a possible alien invasion!

During a pursuit by the Goa'uld gliders, Teal'c fails to make it through the Stargate before it is destroyed. Now SG-1 has only 48 hours to reestablish Teal'c's energy signature from the temporary memory of the Stargate before it's erased…for good!

A truce is declared among the Goa'uld, so that the warlords can attend a summit on the future of universe domination. As Jackson speaks fluent Goa'uld, he is sent to the summit disguised as an aide. But his real mission is to poison the delegates!

Embattled and under siege, SG-1 attempts to escape a Goa'uld search and destroy mission bent on finding them and the secret crystal they carry. Meanwhile, the balance of life is threatened by the reappearance of the evil System Lord Anubis.

As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, SG-1 uses an abandoned Goa'uld ship as a launch pad for a mega-bomb designed to destroy the rock before impact. But when SGC loses the ship's signal, it's feared that the team is dead and that Earth is in peril.

K'tano, former First Prime of the late Imhotep, is now the leader of a powerful Jaffa rebellion. SG-1 visits his stronghold in hopes of securing an alliance. But O'Neill soon learns that this strategic partnership may well come at a heavy price.

A dormant female android discovered on a barren planet is transported back to Earth for study. On reactivation, she exhibits a childlike innocence. But soon, SG-1 discovers that this seemingly innocent being may hold a dangerous secret.

Col. O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson) must enlist the aid of a couple of convicted felons in a bid to save a planet from the Goa'uld. With an attack looming, an entire world's salvation rests in the hands of SG-1 and two former NID operatives.
An expensive jewelry box in discovered among the treasures in Huntington Beach, Calif.; Darrell attempts to reel in a unit; Barry eyes military antiques.

programmes.st: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programmes.d: The girls decide to each bake Berrykin Bloom the perfect cupcake, to be presented at a ceremony honoring him for his achievements in Berryculture.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.
Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures.
Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's 'mood hair' runs amok.
When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.
At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the 'Berry Deep Dark Forest.'
Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling 'Tall Tales.'
Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City.
Sour teasing Apple escalates into a 'prank war' between the two of them.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.
When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some 'groove booties' programmed to dance to any beat.
When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show.
When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time.
Against Strawberry’s advice, Orange adopts a baby fish and discovers she has her hands full when it turns out to be not a fish, but a tadpole-on-its-way-to-being-a-frog!
Plum rallies her friends to be secret 'shoemaker’s elves' for Raspberry and help her finish a dress, but things comically get out of hand.
When the prize violets Lemon is raising for the flower show start mysteriously disappearing, Lemon jumps to some wrong conclusions.
Strawberry has her hands full when she agrees to babysit a young Berrykin who has magical powers.
Lemon orders a new high-tech machine to do salon services faster, then worries that she is no longer needed in the community.
A packaging mix-up at the seed company results in Blueberry planting popcorn instead of daisies.

programmes.st: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programmes.d: Strawberry fills in at the bumblebee post office and learns that sometimes even when you try your very best, things don't always turn out as planned.
Strawberry struggles with how to be the berry best hostess when she has the very worst house guests.
Strawberry and her friends try to break a Berry Bitty World record to win a vacation for Berrykin Bloom.

Plum disregards Strawberry’s rule to sign up for use of the café, and is forced to reschedule a big dance recital. She holds a grudge and starts instigating wacky, nonsensical rules to prove rules are silly.
Berry Bitty City holds an election to see who will fill in as 'BerryFest Princess' while Princess Berrykin is absent.

When Strawberry finds herself in charge of the upcoming BerryFest parade, she hopes her gal pals can help her with the overwhelming amounts of chores. But each of them is rather demanding and ungracious, so they're no use at all.
As this year's BerryFest Princess, Strawberry must learn to be a leader, and overcome many obstacles, to make sure the festival is a success.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: When there's a blackout in Berry Bitty City, Orange discovers she has a fear of what's in the dark: a Galumphalot.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry spends all her time emulating her literary detective hero and ignores her friends, until Strawberry gives her a 'missing person case' to solve—the missing person being Blueberry herself!
When the town’s very formal Berry Bitty Buggy Derby is revived, the girls are unfamiliar with the traditional behavior for the event.
Chaos ensues when Raspberry finds a way to enlarge the Berrykins to the same size as Strawberry and her friends.
Plum, determined to win a Dance-Off trophy, tries to get her friends and the Berrykins to dance just like a rival dance team, and learns that different people have different skills.
When Blueberry gives a First Frost Day 'secret' gift that's more what she wants than what her giftee wants, a hot-potato of passing on the unwanted gift occurs.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the 'Glimmerberry Gathering,' until she learns the true meaning behind the festival.
When the town needs a larger venue for their upcoming Glimmerberry Ball, Plum finds an ideal hollow tree for the occasion.

When the Turtles face Shredder's newest threat, an army of Robot Foot Soldiers, Karai captures Leonardo and forces him to do battle with these new and improved ninjas that can adapt to his every move.
While tracking mutagen, the Turtles bring a mutated squirrel back to the lair. When it starts multiplying, the Turtles must hunt the squirrel mutants and prevent them from escaping into the city.
Donatello obsessively experiments with mutagen in a bid to find a cure for April's mutated father. Unfortunately, this puts April in danger from a new threat—Mutagen Man!
Michelangelo is tired of being the "runt of the litter."  But when he fools around with some mutagen, he gets a dangerous infection that is mutating out of control.
April tries to resume a normal teenage life, but when Karai starts hunting her again, April realizes she may have put her new friend Casey Jones in danger as well.
The Turtles find themselves being hunted by a new threat—another mutant turtle called Slash, who has a personal vendetta against the brothers.

Jazz has noticed a change in Danny ever since "the accident in the lab." She mistakes his ghost hunting for depression and signs him up for therapy with Penelope Spectra. What Jazz doesn't know is that Spectra is a ghost who feeds off teen misery.

When ghosts destroy a student's life and popularity in school, she dedicates her life to hunting ghosts.  Now Danny has to deal with a threat only a few lockers down the hall. and worse?  Danny's best friend, Tucker, has a crush on her.
Danny and Sam find their platonic friendship turned forcibly romantic through the musical powers of Ember, a hard rocking girl ghost who feeds off the idol worship of teens.
Technus - ghost master of technology - has escaped into Danny's online game!  And if they don't stop him, he'll escape into the internet and take over every computer in the world!
Jazz falls for a hunky boy ghost - Johnny 13 - who has the power to cast his shadow out and create bad luck for everyone who crosses him, especially the girls he's dating.
Amity Park learns about the ghost kid and Danny becomes Public Enemy #1.
In an attempt to beat Dash in a haunted house decorating contest, Danny "borrows" the enchanted sword of the Spirit of Halloween, the Fright Knight!
Vlad returns and provides a special bonding opportunity for Danny and his mom.
Paulina discovers Danny's secret and Johnny 13 returns.
Danny and Valerie (the ghost-hunting teen) are forced to work together in order to defeat Skulker in the Ghost Zone.
Vlad returns and puts a bounty on Danny.
Danny and Sam get into a fight, and when Sam utters the words, "I sometimes wish I'd never met you," she finds herself in a world in which she and Danny are strangers.

Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler.  Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job.  His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird.  He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing.  Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programmes.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programmes.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up).  Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid.  The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby.  They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway.  When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic.  Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met.  In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story.  Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programmes.st: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programmes.d: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career.  However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo.  Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch.  Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.
Opie accidentally kills a bird with a slingshot and becomes foster-mother to her three young birds.
An attractive young woman, who has been given a speeding ticket by Andy, pleads not guilty and uses female guile.
Opie must either learn how to box or lose prestige among his peers when a new boy moves into town.
Opie suffers from puppy love so Barney attempts to show him how to handle women.
Opie Taylor develops a crush on his teacher, who also happens to be his father's girlfriend.
Andy has to deliver a baby for a farmer's wife when the local doctor is unavailable.
Opie and his chums take their roles as Robin Hood and his merry men seriously as they befriend a hobo at the expense of the pantries of Mayberry.
Barney disguises himself as a dummy in an attempt to solve a series of theft at the Mayberry department store.

programmes.st: Ernest T. Bass Joins the Army
programmes.d: Guest star Howard Morris plays the part of a mountain man very disgruntled with being rejected by the army.
Barney Fife is convinced that Opie's piggy bank is safer than the Mayberry bank -- and sets out to prove his point.
Barney tries to set Andy up when he mistakenly perceives that Andy is suffering from a broken heart.
Aunt Bee falls for the sales pitch of a fast-talking medicine man and his Indian elixir.
Andy thinks Ellie is out to marry him. After a series of misunderstandings, Andy finally takes Ellie to the church picnic.
Andy refuses to join an exclusive club when Barney's bid for membership is turned down.
Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern criminal detection methods to solve several burglaries at a filling station.
Ernest T. Bass is a would-be Romeo, who is brought into the sheriff's home in an effort to teach him some manners.
Barney is furious when he sees his girl Thelma Lou kiss, Gomer.
Aunt Bee saves money by buying a side of beef. The beef is tough, the freezer conks out, and Gomer attempts to fix the motor.
Barney Fife believes he's hexed when several accidents happen after he fails to continue a lucky chain letter.

This season, the balance of power on the winter roads is turned upside down. Reigning champ Polar Industries returns, looking to maintain their dominance by any means necessary.

In Louisiana, the Swamp Man attempts a daring rescue of his aging relatives from the rising storm waters. In Wisconsin, the Woodchucks don't make their deadline and their company hangs in the balance.
At Rygaard, Gabe is desperate to fill out his shorthanded crew--and brings in someone very unexpected.

In the Bayou, Shelby goes on a treasure-hunting mission, and ends up in a race against Belinda. At Big Gun Logging, Jesse's lesson on the whistles almost takes Luke out. On the river, S&S continues to struggle.

Shelby finds a legendary old gravesite and the crew has an accident. Big Gun has yet another yarder accident and Levi decides to make some major crew changes. Brad and Swilley are the victims of a prank and they lose yet another assistant.

When Willie is looking to hire a new assistant, Korie insists he interviews her cousin, JD. Meanwhile, when Uncle Si spends the day over at Phil and Kay's, Jep stops by with the kids to keep them away from Jessica, who has taken ill.

After seeing footage Jep shot using a GoPro, Si decides he wants to use the camera to record a day in his life. But when Si gets on the guys' nerves while they're hunting, they kick him and his GoPros out of the blind.

When the duck guys have to pull an all-nighter to finish some work, Willie decides he wants to join them. But when a dying smoke detector distracts them from their work, Jase and Willie head off to disarm it.
After visiting a popular burger restaurant, Willie and Jase get into a debate over which of them cooks the best burger, prompting them to challenge one another to a cooking contest.

When Willie and Jase argue over an old GI Joe toy, it leads them into a debate over who would make a better soldier. To settle the score, Willie and Jase head out to the woods with their friends and children for a paintball match.

When Willie gets a soft serve machine for himself, he tells the guys they can't use it until they're done working. But when Jase thinks this is unfair, he takes matters into his own hands and finds a better object to use as motivation.

When Jase finds out Jep is planning to buy his kids a fancy playhouse from a catalog, he and the guys decide to build one for Jep them selves. But when the playhouse ends up looking more like a military-style duck blind.

When Sadie spends the day at Duck Commander for a school project, the guys try to show her the ins-and-outs of how a successful company works. But when Willie questions Jase's ingenuity in creating new products they get into a debate.

Jackie's display at Angel Brinks's party causes a rift. Brandi and Duffey plan a BBQ to get to the bottom of Jackie's behavior. Tami confronts Duffey about her daughter's music video and makes a drastic decision. Presented by VH1.

Tami fires Duffey from her daughter's music video. Angel Brinks and Angel Love have it out with Jackie after her breakdown at Angel Brinks's party. Tami hustles to finish her daughter's music video in time for the release party. Presented by VH1.

Tami gets some scandalous information from a friend. Jackie tries to lose weight in order to keep Doug interested. At Tami's daughter's video release party, Angel Brinks gets blindsided and Jackie finds herself in the line of fire. Presented by VH1.

Jackie asks Malaysia to be by her side during a very personal weight loss procedure. Duffey apologizes to Tami's daughter in an attempt to make things right with Tami. Doug takes Jackie on a romantic date and reveals a huge surprise. Presented by VH1.

As the ladies all prepare for their trip to Portugal, Malaysia attempts to broker a peace between Tami and Duffey. Soon after her arrival, Duffey has second thoughts about her decision to come on the trip. Presented by VH1.

Marshal Vern Fawcett turns in his badge after accidentally shooting an outlaw in the back. When Holcomb's three vengeful brothers ride into Tombstone, Sheriff Hollister helps Fawcett regain his courage for the fight against lawlessness.

Sheriff Clay Hollister encounters three escaped criminals who have just discovered a fortune in silver. They capture him and plan his death to protect their secret. With no guns and his hands tied, Hollister must think fast in order to survive.

A wealthy rancher is killed and robbed of the ranch payroll. With only a horseshoe print to go by, Sheriff Hollister and Editor Claibourne set about trapping the culprit and end up meeting him in a furious fight. Alan Hale, Jr. guest stars.

Hollister is taken prisoner by a trio of fugitives who need him as a guide on their escape route to Mexico. Left with his guns but no bullets, the sheriff searches desperately for a means of escape and must make a last-ditch gamble for survival.

When a British writer arrives in Tombstone to gather material for a series about the American West, he tags along with Sheriff Hollister and a prisoner as they travel to Yuma prison. But the journalist is devising a dangerous plot.

Santiago, a rebel leader mortally wounded in a battle with the despot Commandante Nexor, escapes across the border to Tombstone. He begs his old friend Clay to find his younger brother Juan and bring him to him. But Juan has plans of his own.
Paladin is hired to find a killer. His usual fee is paid for instead with a ring. A ring that may tie his employer to his quarry with him in the middle.
Paladin is hired by a man to deliver ten thousand dollars. Paladin has to sift through a numbr of suspects, including a band of gypsies and the men who found the body.
After a man dies, the reading of his will causes three additional murders.
Paladin goes to inform a cavalry corporal that he has won $600,000 in a lottery. But they may not live to cash in the ticket, they are trapped by several dozen hostile Indians.
A puppeteer gives Paladin a wagon ride to an Army fort commanded by a general with presidential aspirations.

The boys and girls meet for the first time, and they waste no time in getting to know each other. Cartier and Gerard split off from a villa tour to get to know each other. Maurice and Jessie share a moment, while and Matthew and Vanessa cuddle up.

Eoghan gets tongues wagging around the villa, and things take an interesting turn when he gets a text message telling him he has 24-hours to steal the heart of one of the girls. Adam kicks off when he overhears a conversation about him.

Eoghan pulls Cartier aside to check she's okay after his decision and Maurice tries his luck with Cynthia. Eoghan and Jessie share a night together, while Cynthia gets a text, and the Excess Baggage challenge leads to some very unhappy housemates.

Anna and Phoebe make waves as soon as they arrive in the villa. Phoebe admits she's attracted to Cassie. Both Anna and Phoebe get a date with Adam. Jessie plants a big kiss on Eoghan. Matt kicks off and confronts Sam.

Eoghan is stuck in a love triangle between Jessie and Anna, and can't make up his mind. Darts leads to a Phoebe and Cassie sharing a very intimate moment. Gerard and Anna get to know each other more. Cartier is enjoying spending time with Adam.
Jessie and Eoghan revel in their happiness together, while Adam and Cartier share an intimate moment. Cynthia learns some unpleasant truths about Maurice.
The residents of the villa welcome a pair of bombshell twins. It spells double trouble for one newly formed couple.
The twins send hearts racing during a raunchy strip tease in the villa. Plus, Cartier and Adam share a spark on their first date.

Jessie and Eoghan spend the night together in the hideaway. In the villa the twins and Phoebe start spreading rumours about Vanessa. Matt and Vanessa have it out and come out of the situation together still, but only just.

Gerard is relieved to still be in the villa, but now he's the only single person left. Matthew suffers from the rumours flying around the villa, and Vanessa confronts him about not coming to her defence when the whispering began.
Feelings develop following the challenge, and two islanders will leave the villa, in the most intense dumping ever.
The Bomb Squad drops in to stir things up between the islanders. While the boys play, the girls are exiled to the Hideaway.

The OG girls are worrying about the new arrivals, and not without reason. After a nude breakfast and a round of kissing, Gerard is declared the best kisser among the guys. Eoghan has eyes for Issabelle, but he'll have to win her over from Luke.

A game of truth or dare reveals some competition for Jordan's affections between Matthew and Eoghan. Luke can't seem to make up his mind when it comes to either Issabelle and Cassie. New Aaron shakes things up when he arrives in the villa in style.

Aaron has to save two of the four single girls from leaving the villa, and decides on Bianca and Jessie. Gerard and Jessie have a chat by the deck. Cassie grills Luke on what happened while she was gone, and she doesn't like what she finds out.

Aaron and Cynthia spend a romantic evening getting to know each other, while Adam and Cartier get up close and personal after a night spent together in the hideaway. Anna and Cassie have a conversation about the perils of social media.

With Eoghan's departure, Matt admits that he has feelings for Isabelle, who finds herself torn between him and a recently re-available Jordan. Aaron and Cynthia, and Gerard and Jessie take their relationships to the next level.

Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?
Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?
The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?
The kids have to find the perfect Secret Santa gifts for each other, because whoever gives the worst gift has to go door-to-door yodeling with Sikowitz!
Tori and the gang are forced to spend a Saturday in detention after a lunch trip gone wrong. They have the whole day to learn about each other, find food, and try not to earn more detention.
Jade and Beck help Sinjin with his new game show, "The Worst Couple," but it puts their relationship to the test.  Meanwhile, Tori breaks her precious Pear Phone.
Tori notices some changes in her friend Andre, whose girlfriend seems to be overbearing and controlling. Meanwhile, Jade and Cat try to earn easy money dog-sitting in Beverly Hills.
Cat's favorite actress dies and she talks Tori and Jade into driving to the actress' house to hold a vigil. Meanwhile, Trina directs a play starring herself, with Beck, Andre, and Robbie.
Tori and Jade play a married couple putting their acting abilities and uneasy friendship to the test. Meanwhile, Cat & Robbie start a service where they deliver bad news in a friendly way.
In an effort to take more risks as an actress, Tori goes to an underground spot called "The Gorilla Club."  Meanwhile, Andre and Robbie lose a very interesting bet to Jade.
When a movie shoot causes a traffic jam and interferes with Tori's morning commute, she turns to her friends for help.  Meanwhile, Cat becomes addicted to an email coupon service.
Andre, Jade, Cat, and Beck trade urban legends about how Trina got accepted into Hollywood Arts.  Meanwhile, Tori and Robbie are stuck at Nozu unable to pay their bill.
A strange new student named Ponnie befriends Tori but keeps disappearing around other people.  Everyone worries Tori might be losing it, but Tori suspects that something more sinister is afoot.
When Freddie saves Carly's life, Carly falls in love with him. Meanwhile, Sam and Spencer compete against each other in a paintball game called Assassin.

programmes.d: When Gibby discovers Freddie and his girlfriend in a compromising position, he vows revenge and challenges Freddie to a fight.  Meanwhile, Spencer's art career really takes off when the local paper incorrectly reports his death.

When the gang discovers that Lewbert was once a happy man engaged to a beautiful woman, they set out to reunite the lost lovers. Spencer joins the building watch to catch a thief that's been stealing from the apartments.

programmes.d: Sam reveals to Carly and Freddie that she used to compete in pageants as a young girl.  When she learns that her long-time rival will be competing in Seattle, she convinces Carly to compete against her.
When Sam ends up in jail, Carly and Freddie vow that the web show must go on.  They try to enlist Spencer's help at that last minute but he has a date he can't cancel.

An eccentric billionaire asks the iCarly gang to perform the first live web show from outer space.  They go through a series of tests to make sure they're fit for space travel.  Back at the loft, Spencer is visited by a mysterious little girl.

Bigfoot fever hits Seattle when hikers take some fuzzy footage of a suspicious figure in the woods.  After an expert validates the footage on the web show, Carly convinces the gang to go upstate and join the search for Bigfoot.

Fed up with his Mom constantly treating him like a baby, Freddie decides to move out into his own place.  The gang starts a successful pet photography business.  They end up in a feud with a rival pet photo studio.
